score_notes: World-class off-piste (Stockhorn/Rote Nase, Schwarztor, Klein Matterhorn glacier itineraries) with deep guide culture; Haute Route terminus and 4000er ski tours (Breithorn, Monte Rosa) make it a global touring hub.
comments: Year-round glacier skiing (365 days, Matterhorn glacier paradise). 2025/26 winter timetable from 1 Nov 2025 (Klein Matterhorn–Trockener Steg), other sectors 29 Nov and 6 Dec 2025; 2026/27 winter product 1 Nov 2026–3 May 2027. Dynamic pricing: official page shows only 'from CHF 89' (Zermatt) and 'from CHF 104' (International) for 2026/27; skiinfo lists Zermatt day pass CHF 96, skiresort CHF 116 (likely International peak). Car-free: park at Matterhorn Terminal Täsch (shuttle train). Official top 3883 m; skiresort 3899 m. From Italy via Simplon (car train Iselle–Brig as backup). Price range: CHF 88 (Sat 24 Jan 2026, Blick comparison) to CHF 96 (skiinfo list); International pass up to about CHF 116.

ski_area: Chamonix Mont-Blanc (Brévent-Flégère, Grands Montets, Balme, Aiguille du Midi)
score_notes: Former FWT venue; Vallée Blanche, Grands Montets and Brévent couloirs; Haute Route start with Compagnie des Guides/ENSA make it a world touring hub.
comments: Via Mont Blanc tunnel (no extended closure in 2026, only autumn night closures); Col des Montets may close for avalanche risk. Aiguille du Midi 3842 m = lift-served glacier off-piste (Vallée Blanche, Mont Blanc Unlimited pass), cable car closed 2 Nov-18 Dec 2026; marked pistes top out at 2765 m (Bochard) while Grands Montets summit 3275 m stays closed until Dec 2027 (new Argentière-Lognan gondola due summer 2026, Plan Joran gondola reopens 5 Dec 2026). 2025/26 opened 29 Nov (Grands Montets Plan Joran/Bochard/Tabé + Flégère), Brévent and Balme 13 Dec, Les Houches 6 Dec. Dynamic online pricing from 47 EUR off-peak; 74 EUR = peak ticket-office price 20 Dec-27 Mar; Mont Blanc Unlimited 1 day 100 EUR. skiresort.com sums valley areas incl. Les Houches to about 169 km. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-11-28, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Strong lift-served off-piste (Vallons de la Selle, Vallons du Diable, Chalance, Dome de la Lauze descent towards La Grave with a guide) and a big guide scene; the brief's rubric names Les 2 Alpes as a 4.0 touring example (Ecrins access, Vallon de la Selle, Pied Moutet).
comments: No autumn glacier opening since 2023, winter now starts late November; 2025/26 planned opening 29 Nov 2025 not independently confirmed as operated; official 'Hiver 2027' skipass page lists SKIPASS JOURNEE adult 68.00 (skiresort shows 66 for 2025/26); official top 3600 m is a marketing figure, skiresort gives 3523 m; family/tribe passes use period tiers (avant saison, saison 19 Dec-9 Apr, fin de saison); Supernova pass adds Alpe d'Huez and La Grave; glacier skiing continues to early July.

score_notes: Glacier-based off-piste (Feechopf, Längfluh, Plattjen) with strong guide offices; classic 4000er ski tours (Allalinhorn, Alphubel, Strahlhorn, Britannia hut) give reliable high-alpine touring.
comments: Glacier summer/autumn skiing from 12 Jul 2025 (2025/26) and 18 Jul 2026 (skiresort 2026/27 season 18 Jul 2026–18 Apr 2027); official season statement 'Saas-Fee 1 Nov 2026–18 Apr 2027' while the timetable shows first winter lifts Sat 31 Oct 2026. Fixed 1-day adult CHF 84 (2026/27, Saas-Fee + Saas-Almagell). Car-free village: car journey ends at the Parkhaus at the village entrance. Official 'up to 3600 m'; skiresort 3573 m. From Italy via Simplon.

score_notes: Legendary lift-served freeride (Vallons de la Meije, Chancel, Trifides) with a guide-dominated culture and the Derby de la Meije; La Meije/Ecrins and Col du Lautaret provide dense high-alpine touring classics.
comments: Cable car 20 Dec 2025-3 May 2026, full day pass 66 EUR official 2025/26 (skiresort still lists 62); Girose glacier drag lifts to Dome de la Lauze 3550 m run only when snow/weather allow (typically from Feb), otherwise top is Ruillans 3200 m; no marked pistes off the glacier (19 km of itineraries); Col du Lautaret (D1091) normally open in winter with storm closures; from Italy via Montgenevre-Briancon-Lautaret.

score_notes: High open glacier off-piste (Ventina, Cieloalto) but mostly mellow, guide offices present; touring: Breithorn 4164 m from Plateau Rosa, Valtournenche classics, strong guide culture.
comments: 2026/27 official tariff (Cervino SpA, dated 04.05.2026): Breuil-Cervinia 24 Oct 2026-2 May 2027, Valtournenche 28 Nov 2026-25 Apr 2027; local adult 1-day EUR 64 flat (no seasonal tiers), international with Zermatt EUR 88; October glacier opening skis Plateau Rosa/Theodul (Swiss side, ID document required); 3480 m = Plateau Rosa/Testa Grigia on local pass (Klein Matterhorn 3883 m needs international pass); Glacier Ride II (Matterhorn Alpine Crossing) closed 7 Jan-26 Feb 2027 for maintenance; coordinates = Breuil-Cervinia village.

score_notes: Vallee Blanche and Toula glacier from Skyway, Arp couloirs and Val Veny off-piste with a big guide scene; touring hub for the Mont Blanc massif (Val Ferret/Val Veny classics, Haute Route variants).
comments: 2025/26 official daily rates: EUR 69 high season (20 Dec-6 Jan, 24 Jan-8 Mar), EUR 63 regular; with Skyway Monte Bianco EUR 82/76 (page marked 'tariffe in aggiornamento'); 3466 m = Punta Helbronner via Skyway (separate ticket, off-piste glacier descents only), ski-area pistes top out at 2755 m (Cresta Youla); official claim 'oltre 100 km' includes off-piste; coordinates = Dolonne gondola base with main car park; lift-company domain courmayeur-montblanc.it fails SSL, .com works; webcam page is the tourism consortium's (lift company has none).

score_notes: Rubric benchmark: Grande Motte/Grande Balme/Toviere off-piste, huge guiding scene and freeride-event history; touring 4.5 with Vanoise classics (Col du Palet, Pointe de la Sana, Grande Motte) and reliable snow.
comments: Grande Motte glacier: winter 22 Nov 2025-3 May 2026, no autumn glacier product before the November opening (summer skiing 20 Jun-19 Jul 2026); 2026/27 public rates 12 Dec 2026-23 Apr 2027: joint pass 78 EUR, Tignes-only 70 EUR, lower avant-premiere rates 21 Nov-11 Dec; link to Val d'Isere from 28 Nov 2026; Col de l'Iseran and Petit-Saint-Bernard closed in winter - access via Bourg-Saint-Maurice; base = Tignes-le-Lac (Grande Motte funicular at Val Claret 1.5 km) Milan route forced via Albertville to avoid closed Petit Saint-Bernard.

score_notes: Rubric benchmark 5.0: world-famous off-piste (Tour du Charvet, Banane, Col Pers, Fornet/Pissaillas), deep guiding scene and FWT/FWQ history; touring 4.5 with Vanoise high-alpine classics.
comments: Pissaillas glacier lift-served (Le Fornet); Val d'Isere side reaches 'over 3400 m', 3456 m is the Grande Motte top of the shared area; joint-pass price from Tignes 2026/27 public-rates PDF (Val d'Isere shop is interactive; a Val d'Isere-only pass exists, price not extracted; skiinfo shows 75 EUR joint pass 2025/26); Col de l'Iseran closed in winter Milan route forced via Albertville to avoid closed Iseran, Mont Cenis.

score_notes: Summer training glacier with on-piste focus and little off-piste; spring ski touring on Ortler/Monte Cristallo/Geister from the pass once the road opens (late May).
comments: No winter operation: lifts run 30 May-1 Nov 2026 only (SS38 Stelvio pass road closed in winter, typically Nov-May), so opening date is TBD; price = adult 1-day summer/autumn 2026 pass EUR 61 (Pirovano/SIFAS), the only published tariff; base coordinates = pass summit car parks (2758 m), distance refers to summer access via Bormio; top Monte Cristallo 3450 m; relevant to a 2026/27 dataset only for October skiing.

score_notes: 30 km of marked ski routes and high glacier faces, no major event history; classic Wildspitze tours via Taschachhaus from Mittelberg but limited variety (rubric: most Austrian glaciers 3.5).
comments: 2025/26 day ticket conflicting: 75 (skiinfo Oct 2025, cash desk) vs 77 (skiresort.com); online up to 30% cheaper. 2026/27 prices only in web shop. Base = Gletscherexpress funicular valley station, Mittelberg (1740 m), end of Pitztal road (open in winter). Elevation 3440 = Wildspitzbahn top station.

score_notes: Rubric anchors: 4.0 freeride (glacier and Gaislachkogl off-piste, big-mountain terrain), 3.5 touring (good local tours, Vent/Obergurgl nearby are the real hubs).
comments: Dynamic pricing: 86.50 is the 2026/27 peak-season cash-desk price (19.12.26-06.01.27, 30.01-26.02.27); main season 84.50, pre-season 81; online up to ~22% cheaper. Winter (non-glacier) area opens 12 Nov 2026 (13 Nov 2025 last year). Autumn glacier-only operation requires driving the toll Oetztal Glacier Road to the Rettenbach car park (2670 m). Timmelsjoch closed in winter. 2026/27 glacier date conflicting: 25 Sep (snowplaza), 2 Oct (bergfex/skiinfo), 4 Oct (schneehoehen). Milan route forced via Ötztal Bahnhof to avoid closed Timmelsjoch.

score_notes: Rubric 4.0 example: big lift-served off-piste (Sarenne/Pic Blanc glacier, Combe du Loup, Grand Sablat, Vaujany and Oz couloirs) with an established guide scene; Grandes Rousses touring (Etendard, Col de la Pyramide, Pic Blanc) is documented but the resort is not a touring hub.
comments: 2025/26 pass grid uses period tiers, high season 20 Dec 2025-10 Apr 2026 adult day 66.00 (progressive pricing by period, not dynamic); 2026/27 day price not yet visible (JS ticketing site); a snow-dependent early weekend 29-30 Nov 2025 was floated but no confirmation found, official opening 6 Dec 2025; from Italy either Frejus tunnel-Grenoble or Montgenevre-Briancon-Col du Lautaret (kept open in winter, storm closures possible).

score_notes: Oz's Poutran gondolas give direct access to Grand Domaine off-piste (Vaujany couloirs, Alpette, Sarenne) but the resort itself is small and family-focused; local touring options are limited.
comments: Purpose-built Oz station at 1350 m (marketed as Oz 3300), gondolas to L'Alpette and Alpe d'Huez; type reflects glacier terrain reached via the linked Grand Domaine; Grand Domaine pass is the standard product and sector passes were not verified; webcam page sits under the summer path but is the live multi-cam page; 2026/27 day price not yet published. Milan route forced via Bourg-d'Oisans to avoid closed Glandon.

score_notes: Vaujany sector (Dome des Rousses 2800 m, Montfrais) offers steep, less-tracked off-piste inside the Grand Domaine; touring towards the Grandes Rousses, Etendard and Col du Sabot is documented and the village is quieter than Alpe d'Huez.
comments: Village at 1250 m with a large cable car to L'Alpette/Dome des Rousses (base = cable-car station in the village); type reflects glacier terrain reached via the linked Grand Domaine (Sarenne), none in the Vaujany sector itself; Grand Domaine pass is the standard product and sector-only passes were not verified; 2026/27 day price not yet published. Milan route forced via Bourg-d'Oisans to avoid closed Glandon.

score_notes: FWT Xtreme Verbier finals venue (Bec des Rosses), Mont Fort/Mont Gelé/Vallon d'Arbi itineraries and 7 marked freeride routes; Haute Route Chamonix–Zermatt passes Verbier with Grand Combin/Rosablanche tours and a dense guide scene.
comments: Fixed prices 2026/27: Verbier–Tzoumaz 1-day CHF 86, 4 Vallées CHF 94, Bruson CHF 63; -10% online if bought 10+ days ahead. Official pass season Verbier–Tzoumaz 5 Dec 2026–25 Apr 2027 (4 Vallées 12 Dec 2026) but November weekend openings are usual: skiinfo lists 7 Nov 2026 and skiresort 14 Nov 2026 (provisional). Mont Fort glacier (3330 m) needs the 4 Vallées pass. Base = Médran gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel (pass road closed in winter).

ski_area: Engadin St. Moritz (Corvatsch–Furtschellas; regional Engadin pass)
score_notes: Strong glacier-based freeride from the 3303 m summit (Corvatsch glacier descents, Fuorcla Surlej, Hahnensee itinerary, 'big-mountain feel' per skiresort.com) with local guiding but no FWT stop; touring per rubric example (Sils/Bernina 4.5): Piz Corvatsch, Fuorcla Surlej-Roseg, Piz Fora/Val Fex, Coaz and Tschierva huts.
comments: Official press release 'Sportberg Corvatsch eroeffnet Wintersaison' (19.11.2025): 'Am kommenden Samstag, 22. November 2025, startet der Corvatsch in die Skisaison' (Corvatsch Snow Night, Superpipe). Same Engadin regional pass and Snow-Deal dynamic pricing as St. Moritz ('from CHF 55', peak price not published). Base = Corvatsch cable-car valley station Surlej (Silvaplana), large car park; Furtschellas base at Sils. Route from Milan via Chiavenna-Maloja (open, Surlej is 10 min from Maloja side) or Bernina pass; Julier open. Engadin Snow-Deal dynamic pricing from CHF 55; CHF 70 for Sat 24 Jan 2026 (Blick comparison); no upper cap published.

score_notes: Monterosa Freeride Paradise: Indren, Malfatta, Balma and Olen itineraries with strong guide scene and FWQ history; touring to Monte Rosa huts (Gnifetti, Piramide Vincent) and Val Vogna/Turlo.
comments: 29 Nov 2025 is the Monterosa Ski area opening (Ayas/Gressoney); Alagna sector opening date not separately verified (usually a week later); Indren 3275 m is off-piste only, not glacier pistes; coordinates = lower funivia car park in Alagna; access from Milan via Valsesia SP299, no passes. Dynamic pricing 2026/27: adult 1-day EUR 40-71 depending on date and advance purchase (peak dates at top of range), online EUR 5 cheaper than ticket office; Monterosa Ski 3-valley pass is the only pass sold for the linked area (Antagnod separate).

score_notes: Gentler Ayas side with Bettaforca/Colle Sarezza off-piste; moderate touring (Palon di Resy, Testa Grigia) and access to the wider Monterosa scene.
comments: Ayas sector tops at Colle Bettaforca 2727 m; 3275 m (Indren, off-piste glacier) is on the same pass two valleys away, hence Non-glacier here; Antagnod is a separate small area with its own pass; coordinates = Champoluc village (Champoluc-Crest gondola base). Dynamic pricing 2026/27: adult 1-day EUR 40-71 depending on date and advance purchase (peak dates at top of range), online EUR 5 cheaper than ticket office; Monterosa Ski 3-valley pass is the only pass sold for the linked area (Antagnod separate).

score_notes: Shares the Indren/Salati freeride terrain with Alagna plus Punta Jolanda and Gabiet off-piste; touring to Monte Rosa 4000ers via Indren and the Gabiet valley.
comments: Lifts start at Stafal (road end, 1825 m); Indren (3275 m, off-piste only) reached via Gabiet-Passo dei Salati; coordinates = Stafal hamlet/lift base. Dynamic pricing 2026/27: adult 1-day EUR 40-71 depending on date and advance purchase (peak dates at top of range), online EUR 5 cheaper than ticket office; Monterosa Ski 3-valley pass is the only pass sold for the linked area (Antagnod separate).

score_notes: Porta Vescovo north faces, Padon and the 12 km Bellunese plus Marmolada glacier off-piste give the Dolomites' best lift-served freeride (rubric example); Marmolada, Sella and Padon offer many documented tours with local guides.
comments: Marmolada glacier lift-served to Punta Rocca (official 3265 m, skiresort 3269 m) but only Dec-Apr, no autumn glacier skiing; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 68 low / 75 high; 2026/27 date not resort-published (arabba.it silent, skiresort lists 28 Nov 2026), taken from Sellaronda opening 4 Dec 2026; Passo Fedaia road to Malga Ciapela can close in winter; from Milan via A22 Ora-Fassa-Passo Pordoi or Belluno-Val Cordevole (no pass).

score_notes: Steep off-piste in the Madritsch bowls and under the Kanzel with local guides; Ortler group is a classic high-alpine touring hub (Cevedale, Suldenspitze, Vertainspitze, spring Ortler) with strong Ortler Skiarena guide culture.
comments: 2026/27 prices published: 1-day adult EUR 63 main season (19 Dec-8 Jan, 30 Jan-12 Mar, 20 Mar-2 Apr 2027), 60 off-season, 53.50 pre/post season (24 Oct-18 Dec 2026, 17 Apr-2 May 2027); official altitude 1900-3250 m, no lift-served glacier piste; 2026/27 start 24 Oct is the published pre-season start, snow-dependent (snowtrex quotes 1 Nov 2026); access only via Val Venosta-Prato allo Stelvio, Passo Stelvio closed in winter. Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Stelvio, Umbrail.

score_notes: Large glacier off-piste (Gefrorene Wand, Kaserer, Larmstange runs) with reliable snow and local guiding but no contest history; touring: classic Tuxer Alps spring objectives (Olperer, Hoher Riffler) from the glacier and Tuxer Joch, typical of Austrian glacier resorts.
comments: Year-round glacier (365-day marketing); 2025/26: glacier reopened for skiing 27.09.2025 after late-summer break (forum), winter tariff 79 EUR valid 04.10.2025-10.05.2026; 2026/27: autumn tariff 68 EUR until 02.10.2026, winter tariff 82 EUR (from 08:00) 03.10.2026-07.05.2027, also valid in Ski- & Gletscherwelt Zillertal 3000 04.12.2026-11.04.2027; +2 EUR keycard; 2+ day tickets only as Zillertaler Superskipass; official webcam page is JS-rendered (alt. https://www.bergfex.com/hintertux/webcams/); from Italy via Brenner, Tux valley road open all year.

score_notes: Orelle side (Bouchet, Rosael, Peyron) has long north-facing off-piste vallons under the 3230 m Pointe du Bouchet chair; touring in the Maurienne side valleys is modest.
comments: Maurienne-side gateway: gondola from Francoz hamlet (D1006; A43/Frejus route from Italy, no winter pass closure) reaches 2300 m in 13 min; 1093 parking spaces at gondola; 2026/27 Orelle-Val Thorens day 73.50 EUR (19 Dec-2 May), 66.10 EUR early season; 10% discount buying online at ski.orelle.net; type follows shared VT-Orelle area (Peclet glacier); 22 Nov 2025 gondola opening = official season date, not separately confirmed

score_notes: FWT Val Thorens Pro stop (2026), Peclet/Thorens glacier and Lac du Lou off-piste above 3000 m; touring via Cime Caron-Col de Thorens and Vanoise access is snow-sure but of limited variety.
comments: Opened 22 Nov 2025 with 18 lifts (Grande Premiere); 2026/27 adult day 73.50 EUR from 19 Dec 2026 (66.10 EUR 21 Nov-18 Dec); Belleville valley pass 79 EUR, 3 Vallees 84.20 EUR (2026/27); Peclet glacier lift-served; highest point Pointe du Bouchet 3230 m (skiresort)

score_notes: Rubric 4.0: FWQ event history, Aiguille Rouge/Grand Col/Villaroger north-face itineraries and Arc 2000 couloirs; touring moderate (Vanoise via Peisey/Rosuel).
comments: Base = Arc 1800 (largest station); alternative car end-point is the Bourg-Saint-Maurice funicular (45.61381, 6.77303); 2026/27 Classic Pass 71 EUR valid 19 Dec 2026-16 Apr 2027, -15% opening/closing weeks and Saturday/Sunday web promos (dynamic pricing); Varet glacier remnant under Aiguille Rouge (skiresort flags glacier) but no glacier ski product Milan route forced via Albertville to avoid closed Petit Saint-Bernard.

score_notes: Same Les Arcs area from the quieter Peisey side; Peisey-Nancroix/Rosuel is a Vanoise touring gateway (Mont Pourri, Col du Palet).
comments: Base = Plan-Peisey (Vanoise Express station towards La Plagne); Vallandry lifts 1 km north; same pass and prices as Les Arcs Milan route forced via Albertville to avoid closed Petit Saint-Bernard.

score_notes: Glacier off-piste from Grawand/Lazaun and Finail with steep north faces; Similaun, Fineilspitze and Weisskugel are classic Oetztal Alps tours from Maso Corto with strong hut tradition and Sept-May snow.
comments: Glacier skiing Sept-May (autumn mostly race training); 2026/27 price list published: 1-day adult EUR 68 Season A (19 Sep-6 Nov 2026), 50 Season B, 57 Season C (9-29 Jan, 27 Feb-19 Mar 2027), 63 Season D (26 Dec-8 Jan, 30 Jan-26 Feb, 20 Mar-2 Apr 2027); valley runs open from 28 Nov 2026; Suedtirol Skiarena pass also valid; dead-end valley from Naturno (no pass); base = Maso Corto/Kurzras glacier cable car.

score_notes: Powder Department with 9 marked freeride runs and Wilde Grub'n route, but mostly moderate glacier terrain; rubric anchor 3.5 touring (Stubai Alps huts, Wilder Pfaff/Zuckerhuetl).
comments: 2025/26 opening: preview articles gave planned 3 Oct 2025 while a skiinfo article suggests an earlier mid-September start; not verified, left blank. 2026/27 fixed prices per bergfex: high season 24.10.26-16.04.27 75.50, autumn 09.10-23.10.26 and spring 64.20. Base = Eisgratbahn valley station Mutterberg (1750 m), end of Stubai valley road (open in winter). Official webcam page returned 404, bergfex used.

score_notes: Big-vertical off-piste from Hohsaas (Trift/Triftalp) marketed as freeride terrain; classic 4000er tours (Weissmies, Lagginhorn, Fletschhorn) start from the lifts.
comments: Demand-based dynamic pricing (official); skiinfo lists 2026/27 day ticket CHF 59, skiresort CHF 62. Other aggregators give 20 Dec 2025 as the 2025/26 opening (one-day conflict with Watson's 19 Dec). Official 2026/27 season 19 Dec 2026–4 Apr 2027. Base = Hohsaas gondola valley station in Saas-Grund. From Italy via Simplon.

score_notes: High glacier terrain (up to 3,122 m) with open off-piste below Schareck/Eissee and ski routes but a small area; touring in the Goldberg group (Schareck, Hoher Sonnblick via Fraganter Huette) is good but typical Austrian-glacier level.
comments: Glacier with autumn-to-late-spring operation: 2026/27 season 23.10.2026-30.05.2027, closed 14.09.-22.10.2026. Adult 1-day 72.00 EUR in all periods (peak 25.12.2026-06.01.2027 and 24.01.-13.03.2027), afternoon ticket 61 EUR; GoPass e-shop advertises online discounts (not itemised). Former domain gletscher.co.at now redirects to moelltaler-gletscher.at. Base = Gletscher Express funicular valley station, Innerfragant (Flattach). From Italy via Tarvisio-Villach-Spittal-Moelltal or Lienz-Iselbergpass (open in winter); no Hochalpenstrasse involved.

score_notes: Hohstock (3118 m) and Sparrhorn off-piste with a local freeride reputation and long ungroomed runs; touring toward Oberaletschhütte/Aletsch glacier area.
comments: Car-free Belalp reached by cable car from Blatten bei Naters. Official belalp.ch shows no winter dates or prices yet (shop script-rendered); price CHF 74 = bergfex high season 2025/26. 2025/26 opening date not found in press lists (Blick overview did not list Belalp). From Italy via Simplon–Brig–Naters.

score_notes: 36 km of marked ski routes/freeride variants and the Black Ibex steep run, quiet glacier with limited size; classic tours (Glockturm, Weissseespitze) but limited variety.
comments: 2026/27: planned 26 Sep 2026 opening postponed on official site (skiinfo.de shows 2 Oct 2026, unconfirmed). 2025/26: open by early Oct 2025 (skiinfo), exact first day not verified. Price 75 = 2025/26 cash-desk day ticket (up to 30% off online). Base = car park at Gletscherrestaurant/Weissseeferner (2750 m) at the top of the toll Kaunertal Glacier Road (open in winter); Feichten village is 25 km down-valley. Elevation 3108 official (skiresort 3113). 2026/27: planned 26 Sep 2026 glacier opening cancelled (rain/warm); new date pending as of 22 Sep 2026; 2025/26 opened 3 Oct 2025.

score_notes: Cult freeride spot (Hockenhorngrat 3111 m descents, freeride events, 1700 m vertical); Lötschental touring classics (Lötschenlücke/Hollandiahütte, Hockenhorn, Petersgrat).
comments: Car-free Lauchernalp reached by the Wiler–Lauchernalp cable car (road head Wiler). Dynamic ski-pass pricing (official tariff page); skiresort main-season CHF 70, bergfex n/a. 2025/26 date is the planned opening from press lists. From Italy via Simplon–Brig–Gampel–Lötschental.

score_notes: Bellecote north face, Friolin and Cul du Nant itineraries are serious but less known and no FWT history; Champagny-en-Vanoise is a gateway to Vanoise touring.
comments: Partial pre-opening (5 lifts, altitude sector, 25 EUR) was scheduled 6-7 Dec 2025 but not verified as run, so the 13 Dec 2025 full opening is used; Bellecote/Chiaupe glacier lifts closed Apr 2023 and dismantled, new Glaciers gondola (Dec 2023) tops at 3080 m on rock - no lift-served glacier skiing (type differs from brief's example; skiresort still lists 3167 m); 2025/26 La Plagne adult day 70 EUR, Paradiski 76 EUR, -15% early/late season; 2026/27 prices not yet published (sales open Sept 2026) Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Petit Saint-Bernard.

ski_area: Engadin St. Moritz (Corviglia–Piz Nair; regional Engadin pass)
score_notes: Corviglia/Piz Nair is mainly a groomed piste mountain with some off-piste (Piz Nair north side, Suvretta) - the serious freeriding is on Corvatsch/Diavolezza on the same pass; touring per rubric example 4.0 (Piz Nair, Piz Julier, Suvretta/Piz Bever tours, Bernina classics nearby, many guides).
comments: Engadin St. Moritz regional ski pass shared with Corvatsch, Diavolezza-Lagalb, Zuoz, Zernez etc. (Snow-Deal dynamic pricing: day/multi-day passes 'from CHF 55'; hotel Sleep+Ski pass fixed CHF 55/day; peak day price not published - only the entry price is given, max left blank). 2025/26 Corviglia first ski day not found (Corviglia normally opens late November; Diavolezza on the same pass opened 18.10.2025) - verify. Base = Signalbahn valley station St. Moritz Bad (Signal car park); alternative Chantarella funicular in St. Moritz Dorf. Route from Milan via Chiavenna-Maloja (open) or Tirano-Bernina (open); Julier open, Albula road closed in winter. 2026/27 date is a resort-supplied season entry on an aggregator (skiresort.com/bergfex); no operator publication found and no 2025/26 date available. Engadin Snow-Deal dynamic pricing from CHF 55; CHF 70 for Sat 24 Jan 2026 (Blick comparison); no upper cap published.

score_notes: Open Faces FWQ venue (Gurgl) with extensive high off-piste on both Obergurgl and Hochgurgl sides; rubric anchor 3.5 for touring (Obergurgl).
comments: Dynamic pricing: 75.50 = 2026/27 peak-season spot (cash-desk) price, high season 69.50, pre-season 64; online early booking cheaper. 1- and 2-day tickets valid only in Gurgl (3+ days Oetztal Superskipass). Timmelsjoch closed in winter. Base = Festkoglbahn valley station car park at Obergurgl entrance. 2025/26 date from forum reports, not an official notice. Milan route forced via Ötztal Bahnhof to avoid closed Timmelsjoch.

score_notes: Glacier freeride with marked freeride routes, Freeride Info Base and FWQ contest history supports 4.0; touring is typical Austrian-glacier level (Hohe Tauern day tours from Kaprun/Kitzsteinhorn) at 3.5.
comments: Glacier with autumn skiing: 2026/27 autumn from 10 Oct 2026 (autumn day ticket 74-77 EUR), winter start period 27.11-18.12.2026 at 74 EUR, peak 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 at 82 EUR (Ski ALPIN CARD, fixed price). Base = Gletscherjet 1 valley station at Kesselfall (Kesselfallstrasse); alternative entry Kaprun Center/Maiskogelbahn in the village via K-ONNECTION. Approach via Felbertauern tunnel (toll) or Tauern motorway - no winter closure. Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Staller Sattel.

score_notes: Rubric example for both: Laub, Galtiberg and Steinberg glacier descents with 2000 m vertical, freeride guiding scene (Engelberg Mountain Guide, FWQ history); touring hub with Titlis, Sustenhorn, Jochpass/Engstlen, Spannort and Trift huts and strong guide culture.
comments: Glacier autumn operation: Titlis glacier skiing opened 11.10.2025 (bergfex season data and regional press announcement; Blick 22.10.2025 lists Titlis among open areas); winter 2026/27 published start 10.10.2026 to 02.05.2027. Dynamic online pricing for the destination ski pass ('book early and reap the rewards'); titlis.ch blocks automated access (HTTP 429) and engelberg.ch only lists sub-area prices (Brunni day ticket CHF 48), so the adult peak day price is left blank - check titlis.ch shop. Titlis Rotair closed for maintenance 03-14.11.2025. Base = Titlis Xpress valley station Engelberg (car park). Route from Milan via Gotthard road tunnel-Stans-Engelberg, no pass closures. Dynamic pricing: skiinfo lists CHF 69 (2025/26) for an adult day pass, entry price from CHF 51 (titlis.ch).

score_notes: Large-resort freeride with marked freeride routes and big terrain (Cassons, Vorab glacier, La Siala, Grauberg), freeride-camp and FWQ history, world-class freestyle rather than steep big-mountain; touring is good but secondary (Vorab/Piz Segnas, Flimserstein, Ringelspitz side).
comments: Vorab glacier allows an autumn start (typically late Oct/early Nov) but the actual 2025/26 first ski day was not found in official news or press - verify. Dynamic pricing (bergfex/laax.com: 'dynamic, depending on the day'); range CHF 55-89 taken from skiinfo (2024/25 data: prices vary 55-82 CHF, list max 89, cheaper via INSIDE LAAX app) - 2025/26 official peak range not retrieved. Flims/Falera villages are alternative bases; base used = Laax Murschetg valley station (main car park). Route from Milan via San Bernardino tunnel-Reichenau-Flims-Laax, no pass closure. 2026/27 date is a resort-supplied season entry on an aggregator (skiresort.com/bergfex); no operator publication found and no 2025/26 date available. Dynamic pricing: Blick comparison shows CHF 77.50 for Sat 24 Jan 2026.

score_notes: Glacier freeride itineraries (Combe d'Audon/Black Wall, Martisberg) and a dedicated ski-tourer gondola; touring to Les Diablerets summit, Oldenhorn and Sanetsch.
comments: Base = Col du Pillon cable car (drive-to; Col du Pillon kept open in winter). Glacier skiing typically early Nov to late Apr/May (skiresort 2026/27: 7 Nov 2026–30 Apr 2027; official ticketing lists Magic Pass winter 07.11.2026–30.04.2027). Les Diablerets village slopes (Meilleret) are on the Villars–Gryon–Les Diablerets pass (bergfex village season 5 Dec 2025). bergfex CHF 84 = Vaud Alps pass; skiresort Glacier 3000 CHF 79. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

score_notes: Steep Stelvio World Cup piste terrain but limited off-piste; touring access to the Ortles-Cevedale group via Valfurva and Stelvio National Park.
comments: 2026/27 official list: high EUR 65 (26 Dec-8 Jan, 30 Jan-27 Mar), low EUR 59, promo EUR 40 until 18 Dec; multi-day passes dynamic with online discounts up to 25%; 2025/26 high was EUR 63; Stelvio and Gavia passes closed in winter (access from Milan via SS38 Valtellina); Milano Cortina 2026 alpine venue; coordinates = Bormio gondola base (Via Funivia); lift-company webcam page https://www.bormioski.eu/en/webcam/ also HTTP 200.

ski_area: Engadin St. Moritz (Val Bernina: Diavolezza–Lagalb; regional Engadin pass)
score_notes: Glacier freeride classic: 10 km Diavolezza-Morteratsch glacier run (longest secured glacier descent in CH), steep Lagalb faces and 10 km of marked ski routes, guiding via Pontresina; touring per rubric example (Bernina 4.5): Piz Palue, Bellavista, Piz Morteratsch, Piz Cambrena, Diavolezza/Boval huts, Bernina pass tours.
comments: Autumn operation: opened for skiing 18.10.2025 as the first Swiss non-glacier-piste ski area (press headlines Engadiner Post 18.10.2025, Presseportal 15.10.2025); skiresort.com season pattern mid-Oct to mid-Nov, then mid-Dec to early May (2026/27: 17.10.2026-02.05.2027). Pistes are on the Diavolezza/Lagalb slopes, the glacier descent is an unprepared marked route - hence Glacier + non-glacier. Engadin regional pass with Snow-Deal dynamic pricing ('from CHF 55', peak not published); a Diavolezza-only ticket may exist (not verified). Base = Diavolezza valley station on the Bernina pass road (car park); Bernina pass kept open in winter, direct route from Milan via Tirano-Poschiavo (Italian side). Engadin Snow-Deal dynamic pricing from CHF 55; CHF 70 for Sat 24 Jan 2026 (Blick comparison); no upper cap published.

score_notes: Small but high (1800-3000 m) north-facing lift-served off-piste from the 3000 m T-bar (Vallonnet, Andagne) with very reliable snow; Haute Maurienne touring mecca (Albaron, Ciamarella, Ouille Noire, Ecot valley, Col de l'Iseran) with an active guide bureau.
comments: Col de l'Iseran closed in winter, dead-end valley reached from Lanslebourg (Mont-Cenis pass also closed); 2026/27 1-day 38.20 at the window and 37.20 online; 6/7-day passes valid across Haute Maurienne Vanoise (350 km); only 25 km of pistes (inclusion basis is altitude/touring); official top 3000 m vs skiresort 2947 m; base = La Pierre Fendue car park by the lifts. Milan route forced via Modane to avoid closed Mont Cenis.

score_notes: Presena glacier and Paradiso off-piste plus Tonale freeride zones; classic Adamello-Presanella ski tours (Pian di Neve, Rifugio Mandrone) start from the pass.
comments: 2026/27 official 1-day adult: EUR 70 (26 Dec-10 Jan and 6-28 Feb), EUR 66 (5-8 Dec, 19-25 Dec), EUR 62 (9-18 Dec), EUR 52-54 season start/end; Smart Skipass online dynamic discounts up to 25%; season 4 Dec 2026-2 May 2027 but Presena glacier usually opens earlier (22 Nov 2025; skiresort lists 21 Nov 2026); Passo Tonale road SS42 open all winter from Ponte di Legno; official site quotes 3016 m top, skiresort/press 3000 m; typed Glacier per brief example although most of the 100 km is non-glacier; coordinates = Passo del Tonale.

score_notes: Pejo 3000 cable car opens steep off-piste on the Cima Vioz flank and Val de la Mare; gateway to Ortles-Cevedale classics (Vioz, Cevedale, Palon de la Mare, Rif. Larcher) though the lift network is tiny.
comments: 2026/27 price list published: 1-day adult EUR 60 Christmas-New Year (20 Dec 2026-6 Jan 2027), 54 high season (7 Jan-14 Mar 2027), 49 low; 2025/26 was 58/52/48; 7 lifts in Stelvio National Park; Combi and Skiarea Campiglio passes also sold; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 3 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027 (unverified); base = Pejo Fonti gondola; from Milan via SS42 Passo del Tonale (open in winter) or A22-Val di Sole.

score_notes: Limited but quiet off-piste around Bella Tola/Illhorn; good local touring (Bella Tola, Meidpass, Turtmanntal access) with less variety.
comments: 2026/27 official: weekends from mid-November if snow allows, full season 18 Dec 2026–11 Apr 2027 (skiresort lists 28 Nov 2026). 2025/26 date based on a conditional press statement. Base coordinates approximate: Saint-Luc funicular valley station (Route du Funiculaire). Official 'up to 3000 m'; skiresort 2980 m. From Italy via Simplon.

score_notes: Steep, high-vertical off-piste from Schilthorn/Birg (Engetal couloirs, Kanonenrohr, Blumental, Schilthorn north-side itineraries) and the Inferno race heritage, but no FWT/FWQ venue history; touring: Sefinenfurgge, Rottal, Tschingelhorn/Petersgrat and Bluemlisalp-hut classics from Stechelberg/Muerren with Lauterbrunnen-valley guides.
comments: Car-free: road head Stechelberg (Schilthornbahn valley station, direct cable car to Muerren; alternative Lauterbrunnen via BLM cable car + train, both with car parks). 2025/26: weekend-only skiing 1/2, 8/9, 15/16 Nov 2025 (Muerren-Birg cable car, Riggli chair, Engetal pistes), continuous from 22.11.2025 to 26.04.2026. 2026/27 date 07.11.2026 is from skiresort.com (official jungfrau.ch pass validity starts 21.11.2026) - verify with Schilthornbahn. Fixed prices as Jungfrau Ski Region (CHF 79/83 high season 2025/26; pass valid uphill only on Muerren-Schilthorn top section). Schilthorn summit closed during 2025 cable-car rebuild, final new section opened 02.04.2026. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-11-07, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted. Milan route forced via Lucerne to avoid closed Susten.

score_notes: Rubric example: Gemsstock is a top-tier lift-served freeride mountain (Guspis, Felsental, Giraffe, Sonnenpiste variants) with strong guiding scene and FWQ/Open Faces history; touring hub of the Gotthard/Urseren region (Pizzo Centrale, Piz Badus, Maighels and Vermigel huts, Winterluecke-Realp classics) with deep guide culture.
comments: Dynamic pricing: day-pass prices set daily (weekday, booking date, weather); CHF 89 = skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 list also 89), official 2025/26 peak range not published as a table - dynamic pricing. 2025/26 Gemsstock first ski day not found (Urner Zeitung reports season-opening event 09.12.2025; regional press indicates Central Swiss resorts started ~22.11.2025) - verify. Oberalp pass closed in winter (Andermatt-Sedrun link by ski/train only, car train not counted); from Milan via Gotthard road tunnel and Schoellenen road (open). Base = Andermatt railway station / Guetsch-Express valley station car parks; Gemsstock cable car 500 m away. 2026/27 date is a resort-supplied season entry on an aggregator (skiresort.com/bergfex); no operator publication found and no 2025/26 date available.

score_notes: Mont Vallon and Gebroulaz glacier itineraries plus Roc de Fer/Col du Fruit off-piste, but a mainly on-piste family resort; touring limited to the Vanoise fringe (Refuge du Saut).
comments: Incl. Meribel-Mottaret; Meribel valley day price not shown in static HTML of the official shops (2026/27 high season 19 Dec-2 Apr: 2-day 142.40 EUR, 6-day 356 EUR; 3 Vallees day 84.20 EUR) - left blank; valley km not stated on official pages fetched; Mont Vallon 2952 m from Wikipedia cross-check

score_notes: Canalone and Pizzo Groppera north-face off-piste are well known regionally; touring in the Val di Lei/Spluga area and Pizzo Stella.

score_notes: FWQ 2026 venue and Plaine Morte glacier/Faverges off-piste but not a renowned freeride destination; touring toward Wildstrubel/Plaine Morte with moderate variety.

Plaine Morte opened 3 Dec 2025. Elevation 2927 m from skiresort (official says 'up to 3000 m'). Base = Crans Cry d'Er gondola (Montana–Arnouva gondola is the alternative base). From Italy via Simplon. Dynamic pricing: CHF 69 for Sat 24 Jan 2026 (Blick comparison) up to CHF 89 list price.

score_notes: Official 1,500 ha Freeride Arena in 6 sectors with 5 ski routes, freeride checkpoint and Open Faces FWQ contests justify 4.0; Heiligenblut is a classic high-alpine touring base of the Glockner/Goldberg groups (Hoher Sonnblick, Schareck, Glocknerrunde) with strong guide culture. Calibrated to 3.5 (modest lift network).
comments: Dynamic pricing (skisport.com/Grossglockner): 2026/27 day tickets advertised 'from 44.50 EUR', season pass 520/650 EUR; no fixed peak-window day price published, so price left blank - coordinator may query the online shop for a Christmas/February date. skiresort.com gives 19.12.2026 as 2026/27 start vs 18.12.2026 on heiligenblut.at. Grossglockner Hochalpenstrasse closed in winter - access from Italy via Lienz-Iselsberg pass (B107, open) or Spittal-Moelltal-Winklern. Base = Rossbach valley station (Schareckbahn), Heiligenblut. Official lift-company domain grossglockner-heiligenblut.at timed out; skisport.com/grossglockner used.

score_notes: Wild, uncrowded off-piste under the Monte Rosa east face from Passo Moro (1000 m+ vertical) known to Piedmont freeriders; touring in Valle Anzasca/Passo Moro with sparse infrastructure.
comments: Monte Moro cable car: accident 30 Dec 2025 (cabin hit upper station, 6 injured); Bill-Monte Moro section judicially sequestered, released 17 Jul 2026, municipality ordered works to restore full operation for winter 2026/27 (not yet confirmed); Staffa-Alpe Bill funivia and Belvedere chairs reopened 19 Jul 2026 (Pecetto-Belvedere chair to be replaced by gondola); no lift-served glacier skiing (skiresort glacier tag refers to Monte Rosa views); 2900 m top only valid if Monte Moro section runs; price EUR 34 from dovesciare/skiresort (official macugnagamonterosaski.com blocked) - verify lift status before season; coordinates = Staffa (funivia base).

score_notes: Renowned Valais freeride area (Grimentz Lona/Orzival and Zinal Sorebois faces) with FWQ history; Zinal is a touring hub (Bishorn via Cabane de Tracuit, Imperial Crown huts).

Prices: skiresort CHF 73 (2025/26), skiinfo CHF 72 (2024/25); official tariff page is script-rendered. Base = Grimentz–Bendolla gondola. From Italy via Simplon.

score_notes: Limited off-piste on the Vallecetta/Sobretta slopes; major ski-touring gateway to Forni-Cevedale-San Matteo (Rifugi Pizzini, Branca) and Gavia tours.

score_notes: Few lifts but wild off-piste; Arolla is a classic Haute Route stage with Pigne d'Arolla, Mont Blanc de Cheilon and Vignettes/Dix hut tours and a long guide tradition.

Espace Dent-Blanche pass links Arolla/Evolène/La Forclaz (>100 km, 1400–3000 m). bergfex shows only the CHF 50 pre/late-season 2025/26 price (skiresort also 50). score_notes: Large high resort with well-known off-piste (Piz Val Gronda, Palinkopf, Samnaun side) and guide offices; rubric anchor 4.0 for touring (Paznaun/Silvretta day tours from Ischgl).

score_notes: Large high-altitude resort with extensive lift-accessed off-piste (Palinkopf, Greitspitz, Piz Val Gronda, Alp Trida side) and a strong local freeride scene but no FWT stop; touring from Samnaun is decent (Muttler, Piz Mundin, Stammerspitz) but secondary to lift skiing.

Duty-free enclave: road access only through Austria (Landeck-Pfunds-Spiss-Samnaun) or from the Engadin via Martina-Vinadi-Spiss; from Milan via Reschen pass (open) or the Engadin. Base = Samnaun-Ravaisch cable-car valley station (Twinliner, car park).

score_notes: Eggishorn/Bettmerhorn off-piste routes above the Aletsch glacier; Fiescheralp is a classic start for Konkordiahütte/Aletsch glacier and Lötschenlücke tours.

score_notes: Good but not famous lift-accessed off-piste (Weisshorn, Hoernli, Urdenfuerggli/Urdental itineraries) without FWT/FWQ history; touring is solid locally (Aroser Rothorn, Erzhorn, Schiesshorn, Furcletta-Arosa classics) but less varied than the big hubs.

Dynamic pricing ('the earlier you book, the lower your price'); CHF 89 = skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 also 89), official peak range not published as a table. Base = Arosa railway station / Weisshornbahn valley station car park; Arosa road from Chur open all winter. Route from Milan via San Bernardino tunnel-Chur-Arosa. Dynamic pricing: CHF 61 for Sat 24 Jan 2026 (Blick comparison) up to CHF 89 list price.

score_notes: Rothorn and Staetzerhorn offer good but moderate off-piste, no FWT/FWQ history (World Cup and MTB venue instead); touring: Lenzerhorn, Piz Scalottas, Parpaner Rothorn and Staetzerhorn day tours, decent snow but limited alpine scale.

Same dynamic pricing and CHF 89 list figure as Arosa. Base = Rothornbahn valley station Lenzerheide (car park). Route from Milan via San Bernardino-Chur-Lenzerheide or Julier-Tiefencastel-Lenzerheide (both open). Dynamic pricing: CHF 61 for Sat 24 Jan 2026 (Blick comparison) up to CHF 89 list price.

score_notes: Family-oriented on-piste resort with limited off-piste; modest local touring (Seetalhorn, Wannihorn) in the Mattertal.

Prices from skiinfo (2026/27 day pass CHF 69); official shop is script-rendered; skiinfo Valais list also gives 12 Dec 2026. Base = Hannigalp gondola valley station. From Italy via Simplon–Visp–St. Niklaus.

score_notes: Small area but the steep, north-facing Dachberg flanks (Leis, Dachberg couloirs) have a cult freeride reputation and near-empty lifts, no event history; the Valser valley is a classic touring destination (Zervreila, Laenta hut, Fanellhorn, Piz Aul, Guraletsch) with good snow but limited lift support.

score_notes: Rubric example (4.0/4.0): Parsenn/Weissfluh long off-piste descents to the Praettigau, Pischa as dedicated freeride mountain, Jakobshorn side-country, historic Parsenn Derby; touring: Fluela and Dischma/Sertig valleys, Fluela Schwarzhorn, Piz Grialetsch, Kesch and Silvretta hut tours - many documented day tours.

score_notes: Shares Parsenn with Davos (Gotschnawang/Drostobel and Parsenn descents to Kueblis and Klosters are freeride classics) plus Madrisa off-piste; touring: Silvretta and Vereina huts, Madrisa-Gargellen crossing, Casanna/Weissfluh tours - many documented day tours.

Base = Gotschnabahn valley station Klosters Platz (railway station, car park). Access from Milan via the Engadin + Vereina car train (Sagliains-Klosters Selfranga) or via Chur-Landquart-Klosters; Flueela closed.

score_notes: Rubric example: Disentis (Pez Ault, Lai Alv, Gendusas couloirs) has FWQ history and a strong freeride reputation for its steep north-facing terrain; touring: Val Medel/Cavardiras and Medelser huts, Piz Ault, Oberalpstock, Lukmanier tours - many documented day tours and a good base.
comments: Disentis sells a local day ticket (CHF 64 adult main season per skiresort.com) besides the dynamic SkiArena Andermatt-Sedrun-Disentis pass (~CHF 89); check which the coordinator wants. 2025/26 first ski day not found - verify. Lukmanier pass closed in winter (treat as closed) - from Milan via San Bernardino-Chur-Ilanz-Disentis. Milan route forced via Chur to avoid closed Lukmanier.

score_notes: Small lift system with good snow but little lift-served freeride; the Queyras (Saint-Veran, Pic de Caramantran, Tete des Toillies, hut-to-hut circuits) is one of France's best-known ski-touring valleys with dense Camptocamp coverage.

score_notes: Renowned off-piste itineraries (Bus de Tofana, Forcella Rossa, Lagazuoi-Armentarola, Cristallo) with Guide Alpine Cortina and freeride schools; Tofane, Cristallo and Fanes host many documented ski tours; no FWT stop.

score_notes: Family/on-piste oriented resort with some marked ski routes but no notable freeride reputation; limited touring (Samnaun group day tours).

Base = Schoenjochbahn valley station in Fiss (direct car park); Serfaus village is traffic-calmed (park at entrance, Dorfbahn underground to Komperdellbahn). 2026/27 opening 4 Dec 2026 per bergfex/skiinfo/skinachrichten, skiresort.com shows 5 Dec. Official St. Anton webcam page (stantonamarlberg.com/en/webcams) returned 503 at final check (200 earlier); official Ski Arlberg lift-company St. Anton webcam page used instead.

score_notes: Snowiest sector of the Arlberg (approx. 11 m/season) with well-documented tree and bowl off-piste, linked to Lech-Zuers terrain; touring in Bregenzerwald/Lechquellen moderate.
comments: Local Warth-Schroecken lifts top out around 2050 m; 2811 m is the Ski Arlberg pass maximum (linked via Auenfeldjet). Hochtannberg pass road (Bregenzerwald side) normally open in winter; Warth-Lech road closed in winter. Base = Steffisalp-Express valley station, Warth (OSM/Nominatim). Price = Ski Arlberg 2026/27 high-season tariff (partner tariff table). skiinfo.de lists 5 Dec 2026 as planned opening vs official 4 Dec. Milan route forced via Schoppernau to avoid closed Lech–Warth road (Tannberg).

score_notes: La Masse sector (Vallon du Lou, Lac du Lou) offers good north-facing off-piste; no FWT history; touring limited to Belleville valley routes.
comments: 2025/26 Les Menuires/Saint-Martin adult day 67 EUR (20 Dec 2025-10 Apr 2026, official PDF; Belleville valley pass 77, 3 Vallees 81.80); 2026/27 day price not yet online (sales open early Oct 2026; 3 Vallees 84.20, Belleville valley 79); Pointe de la Masse gondola top altitude not verified on fetched sources (Sevabel map shows 3 Marches 2704 m)

score_notes: Shares the Les Menuires-La Masse pass; village-side terrain (Roc de Fer, Tougnete) is mostly on-piste with no notable freeride or touring reputation.
comments: Usual opening 13 Dec; opened 6 Dec 2025 with Les Menuires thanks to snow; base = Saint-Martin 1 gondola in the village; price/km = Les Menuires-Saint-Martin pass (2025/26 67 EUR); Pointe de la Masse altitude not verified

score_notes: Renowned off-piste in the Monetier/Yret, Cucumelle and Tabuc sectors with a strong guide-bureau scene; the adjacent Col du Lautaret-Cerces-Ecrins zone is one of France's densest day-touring areas (Camptocamp).
comments: 2025/26 peak price valid 20 Dec 2025-27 Mar 2026 (early season 52.50); 2026/27 prices not yet official (forum reports 68 EUR day pass); Briancon sector opened one week later (13 Dec 2025); from Italy via Col de Montgenevre (open all year); base = Chantemerle (Saint-Chaffrey) cable-car village, OSM hamlet point ~300 m from lift.

score_notes: Mont Valaisan sector (2800 m) and the La Thuile side offer good off-piste plus heliskiing from Italy; touring around Petit-Saint-Bernard/Col de la Traversette is decent but not a hub.
comments: Linked to La Thuile (IT); Petit-Saint-Bernard road closed in winter, so from Italy drive via Mont Blanc tunnel-Bourg-Saint-Maurice; day price: official 2026/27 grid is JS-only, 58 EUR = skiresort main-season day ticket (skipass.com 57 EUR for 2024/25), 'Je skie au soleil' web promo 35 EUR in low season; a La Rosiere France-only pass is also sold Milan route forced via Albertville to avoid closed Petit Saint-Bernard.

score_notes: North-facing, snow-sure domain with some off-piste under the Mont-Cenis ridge but a mainly on-piste family profile; Haute Maurienne is a major French touring valley (Vanoise classics) though the hubs are Bessans and Bonneval rather than Val Cenis.
comments: Col du Mont-Cenis closed in winter, so access from Italy is via the Frejus tunnel and Modane; base = Lanslevillard (Val Cenis le Haut gondola); 2025/26 official calendar said Sat 13 Dec 2025 while one aggregator says 14 Dec; valcenis.com domain page says 12 Dec 2026 but its pass page says Sunday 13 Dec 2026 for the discount week; 2025/26 adult day about 49.50 (skiresort); 6-day+ passes add one day at each other Haute Maurienne Vanoise resort. Milan route forced via Modane to avoid closed Mont Cenis.

score_notes: Steep north-facing off-piste under Belvedere and Fourclaz, less known; touring around Piccolo San Bernardo and Rutor (Rifugio Deffeyes) classics.
comments: Only the Espace San Bernardo pass is sold (valid also La Rosiere, FR): 2025/26 adult 1-day EUR 58 flat, promo EUR 39 in opening weeks; 2800 m = Mont Valaisan on La Rosiere side, La Thuile side tops at Belvedere 2641 m; Little St Bernard pass road closed in winter (link by lifts only); coordinates = Les Suches DMC base station; skiresort lists 2026/27 start 28 Nov 2026 (unconfirmed).

score_notes: Jafferau and Colomion off-piste make it a popular Piedmont freeride spot though small; classic touring in Valle Stretta/Vallee Etroite and Rochemolles.
comments: 2026/27 official prices: weekday EUR 44, weekend/holiday EUR 51, peak 24 Dec-6 Jan EUR 52, promo EUR 40 (5-18 Dec, 30 Mar-11 Apr); 2025/26 was 43/49 and promo 39; season 5 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027 (skiinfo/skiresort); Jafferau top 2800 m; coordinates = Campo Smith base.

score_notes: Wide open freeride bowls off Mottolino and Carosello 3000 with marked freeride zones; local touring in Val Federia/Val Nera with moderate variety.
comments: 2025/26 adult 1-day full price EUR 72 (dovesciare; skiresort 72); 2026/27 winter rates not yet on skipasslivigno.com; access from Milan via Bormio and Passo Foscagno (2291 m, open all winter, winter tyres/chains compulsory 15 Oct-30 Apr), Forcola di Livigno closed in winter, alternative via Switzerland through Munt la Schera toll tunnel; duty-free zone; Milano Cortina 2026 snowboard/freestyle venue; coordinates = village centre (Carosello 3000 gondola). Milan route forced via Bormio to avoid closed Forcola di Livigno.

score_notes: Sansicario is intermediate-piste terrain with little documented off-piste; ski touring around Cesana is limited.
comments: Sansicario sector opened 6 Dec 2025 (Sellette chair + baby lifts); coordinates = Cesana Torinese valley base (Cesana-Sansicario gondola, lowest Vialattea base 1372 m); Sansicario Alto (1700 m) also reachable by road. Peak prices = 2026/27 official online listino (Skimania, verified 10 Sep 2026): EUR 60 24 Dec-6 Jan, EUR 58.50 23 Jan-14 Mar, EUR 52 low; ticket office about +2 EUR (2025/26 pattern), skiinfo quotes EUR 62 window; Italy-only Vialattea pass about 5 EUR cheaper (2025/26: 53 vs 58.50 international); vialattea.it returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch so official pages not directly verified; 2026/27 start: skiinfo 5 Dec 2026 vs skiresort.com 28 Nov 2026 (unconfirmed).

score_notes: Some off-piste toward Monts de la Lune/Montgenevre; moderate touring around Colle del Monginevro and Val Gimont.
comments: Colle Bercia sector opened 6 Dec 2025 (La Coche, Serra Granet chairs); border village linked to Montgenevre (FR), international pass needed for French side; Monginevro pass road open in winter. Peak prices = 2026/27 official online listino (Skimania, verified 10 Sep 2026): EUR 60 24 Dec-6 Jan, EUR 58.50 23 Jan-14 Mar, EUR 52 low; ticket office about +2 EUR (2025/26 pattern), skiinfo quotes EUR 62 window; Italy-only Vialattea pass about 5 EUR cheaper (2025/26: 53 vs 58.50 international); vialattea.it returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch so official pages not directly verified; 2026/27 start: skiinfo 5 Dec 2026 vs skiresort.com 28 Nov 2026 (unconfirmed).

score_notes: Known for tree-lined off-piste around Sportinia/Lago Nero but no freeride events; touring limited (Gran Bosco di Salbertrand area).
comments: Sportinia sector opened 6 Dec 2025 (Sportinia, Rocce Nere chairs); lifts from village (Clotes) and Jouvenceaux; 2789 m is the area max (Monte Motta, Sestriere side). Peak prices = 2026/27 official online listino (Skimania, verified 10 Sep 2026): EUR 60 24 Dec-6 Jan, EUR 58.50 23 Jan-14 Mar, EUR 52 low; ticket office about +2 EUR (2025/26 pattern), skiinfo quotes EUR 62 window; Italy-only Vialattea pass about 5 EUR cheaper (2025/26: 53 vs 58.50 international); vialattea.it returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch so official pages not directly verified; 2026/27 start: skiinfo 5 Dec 2026 vs skiresort.com 28 Nov 2026 (unconfirmed).

score_notes: Olympic piste-focused resort; modest off-piste under Monte Motta/Banchetta; touring possible in nearby Val Troncea but limited variety and guide scene.
comments: Alpette sector opened 6 Dec 2025 (Cit Roc, Trebials, Capret, Garnel chairs). Peak prices = 2026/27 official online listino (Skimania, verified 10 Sep 2026): EUR 60 24 Dec-6 Jan, EUR 58.50 23 Jan-14 Mar, EUR 52 low; ticket office about +2 EUR (2025/26 pattern), skiinfo quotes EUR 62 window; Italy-only Vialattea pass about 5 EUR cheaper (2025/26: 53 vs 58.50 international); vialattea.it returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch so official pages not directly verified; 2026/27 start: skiinfo 5 Dec 2026 vs skiresort.com 28 Nov 2026 (unconfirmed).

score_notes: Motta Naluns has several marked freeride routes and open bowls (Champatsch, Mot da Ri) and a snowboard heritage but no FWT/FWQ history; Lower Engadin touring is good (S-charl, Sesvenna, Piz Nair, Piz Minschun) yet less alpine than the Upper Engadin.
comments: Pricing: fixed prices at the ticket offices, flexible early-booking prices online (official); numeric table not shown on the page - CHF 69 is the skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 also 69). 2025/26 first ski day not found - verify. Base = Motta Naluns gondola valley station next to Scuol-Tarasp railway station (car park). Access from Milan: Flueela pass closed - via Chiavenna-Maloja or Tirano-Bernina to the Engadin then Zernez-Susch-Scuol (Engadin valley road open), or via Austria (Reschen-Landeck-Martina); Ofen pass open.

score_notes: Val Mesdi (Sella) and Lagazuoi/Val Travenanzes descents are Dolomites off-piste classics with guides in Colfosco/Corvara; Sella, Puez and Fanes groups give many documented tours; no FWT venue.
comments: altabadia.org returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so km/elevation are from skiresort (130 km, top 2778 m Lagazuoi); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 72 low / 80 high; 2026/27 opening date not resort-published, taken from the Sellaronda opening (4 Dec 2026); base = Corvara; passes Gardena/Campolongo/Valparola open in winter with possible closures; from Milan via A22 Bressanone-Val Badia.

score_notes: Family resort, mostly on-piste; tree skiing and Foret Blanche off-piste shared with Vars but little freeride profile; limited local touring (Pointe de Razis, Col de Valbelle).
comments: 2026/27: reduced-domain pre-opening 5-11 Dec 2026 then full opening 12 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027 (official); Labellemontagne operator, card 2 EUR, web-only promos (e.g. Saturday pass 46.50 instead of 58 in 2025/26); no Risoul-only day pass found in shop; access from Guillestre (D902/D186).

score_notes: Some lift-served off-piste (Crey du Quart and Setaz combes, Thabor side) but no freeride competition pedigree; well-known spring touring base for Galibier, Cerces and Aiguilles d'Arves classics (Grand Galibier, Pointe des Cerces).
comments: Col du Galibier closed in winter (access via Saint-Michel-de-Maurienne and Col du Telegraphe, kept open); 2025/26 first lifts = planned pre-opening weekend 6-7 Dec 2025 on one massif at 20 EUR, operation not independently confirmed, Valloire-only 13-19 Dec then full Galibier-Thabor 20 Dec 2025; 2026/27 pattern identical (5-6 Dec pre-opening, Valloire-only 12-18 Dec, full domain 19 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027); 2025/26 adult day 53.60; cheaper Valloire-only pass exists only in the early-season week.

score_notes: Regular FWQ/Vars freeride events and Eyssina-Chabrieres off-piste give a real but not world-famous scene; good local touring toward Col de Vars, Parpaillon and the Queyras edge.
comments: 58 EUR quoted on the Vars OT 2026/27 pass page (Friday web offer 46.40) and as base price in the Risoul 2025/26 shop; official 26/27 tariff PDF is image-only; 6 Dec 2025 pre-opening was weather-dependent and not independently confirmed (full domain 12-13 Dec 2025); Col de Vars (D902) normally open in winter: from Italy via Col de Larche-Barcelonnette-Col de Vars or via Briancon-Guillestre; main base Les Claux (Sainte-Marie is the first village from Guillestre).

score_notes: Mostly on-piste with some steep off-piste under Pendine and no competition history; Vallouise-Ecrins (Pelvoux, Ailefroide, Glacier Blanc approaches) is a major touring base 15 min away.
comments: Pre-opening weekends 29-30 Nov and 6-7 Dec 2025 were snow-dependent and not independently confirmed as held (continuous opening 13 Dec 2025 - use that if in doubt); 2026/27: possible weekend 5-6 Dec 2026 then continuous 12 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027; 2026/27 day pass 44 EUR (+2 EUR card), 2025/26 was 41.50; elevation 2750 m official (skiresort 2677 m); two bases: 1400 Les Pres and 1600 Station (main lifts incl. TS Bergerie, coordinates given); night skiing.

score_notes: Thabor sector gives lift-served off-piste bowls and couloirs but the resort has no freeride event history; touring towards Mont Thabor and the Cerces massif is well documented, without a large guide scene.
comments: Base taken as Valmeinier 1800 (main lifts, end of road) rather than Valmeinier 1500 village; 2026/27 pre-opening week 12-18 Dec 2026 limited to the Valmeinier sector (Gros Crey), full Galibier-Thabor from 19 Dec 2026; 2025/26 planned pre-opening 13 Dec then full domain 20 Dec 2025, actual not confirmed; 2025/26 adult day 53.60; Saturday web promo 27.40/41.20.

score_notes: Car-free family resort whose off-piste is limited to tree runs between pistes below the 2750 m summit; Vanoise touring is nearby but the resort itself is not a touring base.
comments: Car-free resort at 1350 m with a free underground car park at the entrance (5 km above Villarodin-Bourget); 2025/26 adult day 43.00; Saturday web promo 31 EUR; 2026/27 keycard 2 EUR extra.

score_notes: Mainly on-piste family area with 11 km ski routes; decent local touring on the Reschen ridge (Piz Lad, Zehnerkopf, Schwarze Wand) but limited variety.
comments: Reschenpass (1504 m) open in winter: most direct Milan route via Bolzano/Val Venosta. 2026/27 adult day pass 70 EUR in all high/low/top periods (pre/late season 45.50) per bergfex price list; online pre-sale cheaper (2025/26 'from 67'). Multi-day passes cover the Two-Country Skiarena with Schoeneben/Haideralm (IT). Base = Bergkastelbahn valley station. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-05, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Grand Couloir and Saulire/Creux Noirs couloirs give real off-piste but the resort is on-piste/luxury oriented with no FWT history; little touring culture beyond the Vanoise fringe.
comments: Villages 1850/1650/1550/Le Praz/La Tania = one row; 2026/27 high-season (19 Dec-9 Apr) adult day 77 EUR, low season cheaper; 3 Vallees day pass 84.20 EUR 2026/27; Courchevel valley km not stated on official pages fetched (3 Vallees 600 km); Saulire 2738 m from Wikipedia cross-check

score_notes: Locally reputed for steep larch-forest and Punta Bagna (2737 m) off-piste on north-facing slopes, but a small area without competition history; touring limited to Mont Thabor and Frejus valley routes.
comments: Closest FR2 resort to the Frejus tunnel exit (about 10 km above Modane); 2025/26 adult day 43.00; free shuttle to La Norma every 45 min and the pass is shared between the two unlinked areas; Parcs & Loisirs lists 20 Dec 2026 but the operator site says Sat 19 Dec 2026.

score_notes: Family-oriented with some off-piste on Drouvet/Rocherousse but no freeride pedigree; the Champsaur-Ecrins south side (Vieux Chaillol, Prelles, upper Drac huts) offers many documented day tours.
comments: Dynamic pricing (Propuls' pass) with online discounts; 46 EUR is the skiresort main-season 2025/26 figure, forfait2ski lists 48.50 EUR (indicative) for 2026/27, official day price not shown on pass.orcieres.com; official km not stated on site; day parkings P4 Drapeaux / P6 Queyrelet at Merlette 1850; access via Gap-Champsaur (D944).

score_notes: Couis 1 and Platta de Grevon off-piste bowls, limited extent; moderate touring on the Pila-Cogne ridge.
comments: 2025/26 adult 1-day EUR 58 flat (dovesciare/skiresort); 2723 m = top station of the new Aosta-Pila-Couis gondola (Stella di Pila), skiresort says 2740; car can alternatively stop at the Aosta town gondola base (about 30 min to 2700 m); coordinates = Pila village car parks; season 5 Dec 2025-3 May 2026; skiresort lists 2026/27 start 5 Dec 2026 (unconfirmed).

score_notes: Sunny, mostly groomed Serre-Poncon resort with modest off-piste (Pousterle, Boussolenc) and no FWQ history; limited touring around the Parpaillon massif.
comments: 2026/27 high season 19 Dec 2026-19 Mar 2027: window 45.50, online 48 h ahead 43.20 (mid season 38.50, low 34.00); 2025/26 day pass 42-44.50 per aggregators; base = Les Orres 1650 centre (Bois Mean 1800 is a second front de neige); access via Embrun (D40).

score_notes: Wide groomed family pistes with a marked freeride area but little steep terrain and no event history; touring around the Surses is good (Piz Mitgel, Piz Arblatsch, Piz Martegnas, Bivio classics nearby) with reliable snow but modest variety.
comments: Dynamic pricing (bergfex/resort: 'dynamic, depending on the day'); no official price range found (skiinfo/skiresort show no figure) - price left blank, check savogninbergbahnen.ch shop. 2025/26 date 13.12.2025 is the planned season start supplied to bergfex, actual not verified. 2026/27: weekend operation Savognin-Piz Martegnas 5/6.12.2026, daily from 12.12.2026, end 29.03.2027. Base = Tigignas 10-seater gondola valley station in Savognin (Veia Riom, car park). Route from Milan via Chiavenna-Maloja-Silvaplana-Julier pass-Bivio-Savognin (Maloja and Julier open in winter) or via Chur-Tiefencastel.

score_notes: Nendaz Freeride FWQ venue (Mont Gond) plus Tortin/Gentianes/Mont Fort off-piste and 6 marked freetracks; documented day tours (Rosablanche, Cleuson/Prafleuri) and a Haute Route variant via Cabane de Prafleuri.
comments: Max 3330 m (Mont Fort, co-managed by NV Remontées Mécaniques and Téléverbier) requires the 4 Vallées pass (CHF 94 in 2026/27); Printse pass tops out lower (Greppon Blanc/Plan du Fou). Printse 1-day adult CHF 79 per skiinfo (2026/27); official shop uses online discounts (page data shows 'from CHF 62'). Base = Haute-Nendaz Tracouet gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon. Top of local Printse pass ~2700 m (Greppon Blanc); Mont Fort 3330 m reachable only with the full 4 Vallées pass.

score_notes: Marked but unsecured Eteygeon freeride itinerary from Greppon Blanc and Thyon–Dixence off-piste; touring mainly toward Val d'Hérens/Dixence with modest variety.
comments: Télé-Thyon SA operates Thyon 2000/Les Collons; Printse pass CHF 79 (skiinfo 2026/27). 3330 m (Mont Fort) only with the 4 Vallées pass; Thyon sector tops at Greppon Blanc (official value not found). Official thyon.ch is in summer mode; 2026/27 date from skiinfo provisional list. Base = Thyon 2000 (drive-to). From Italy via Simplon or Great St Bernard tunnel. Top of local Printse pass ~2700 m (Greppon Blanc); Mont Fort 3330 m reachable only with the full 4 Vallées pass.

score_notes: Shares 4 Vallées off-piste access (Mont Fort/Tortin via pass) but local terrain (Piste de l'Ours, Thyon side) is mostly on-piste; limited local touring.
comments: Lifts operated by NV Remontées Mécaniques (Nendaz–Veysonnaz). Printse pass CHF 79 (skiinfo 2026/27), 4 Vallées CHF 94. 3330 m (Mont Fort) only with the 4 Vallées pass; Veysonnaz's own lifts top out around Greppon Blanc (official value not found). skiresort lists 4 Vallées 2026/27 start 14 Nov 2026 (Verbier side). Base = Veysonnaz gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon. Top of local Printse pass ~2700 m (Greppon Blanc); Mont Fort 3330 m reachable only with the full 4 Vallées pass.

score_notes: Regular Open Faces FWQ 3* venue and host of Freeride Junior World Championships (Quellspitze faces); touring in Paznaun/Verwall decent but less known than Galtuer.
comments: No Kappl-only day ticket: 1-day pass covers Kappl and See (approx. 85 km, 20 lifts); Kappl alone approx. 36-42 km. Single fixed price all season (73 EUR 2026/27). New 10-seat Diasbahn opened Dec 2025. Elevation from skiresort.com. skiinfo.de lists 19 Dec 2026 as planned opening vs official 11 Dec.

score_notes: Sportgastein (1,590-2,650 m) is a recognised freeride area with three official freeride routes, Freeride Info Base, Avalanche Training Center and FWQ history, plus steep Graukogel; Gastein offers good Tauern day tours (Schareck, Baukogel, Sportgastein) but is not a major touring hub. Calibrated to 3.5 (compact area).
comments: Ski amade dynamic pricing: main season 19.12.2026-26.03.2027 adult day online 69.50-81.50 EUR, ticket office 81.50 EUR; start/finale 64.50-76.00; pre/post 59.00. Max elevation = Sportgastein Goldbergbahn top (official 2,650 m); Stubnerkogel 2,246 m. Official km: Sportgastein 24 km, Dorfgastein-Grossarl about 70 km (skiresort figures used for consistency). 2026/27: Stubnerkogel/Schlossalm partial from 27 Nov, daily from 11 Dec 2026; Sportgastein daily from 18 Dec 2026; Graukogel operates only Thu-Sun from late Dec. Base = Stubnerkogelbahn valley station. From Italy via Tauern motorway A10 (or Tauernschleuse car train Mallnitz-Boeckstein) - no winter closure. Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Staller Sattel.

score_notes: Mainly on-piste (Kandahar, Alpspitze); some off-piste on the Zugspitzplatt; touring modest (Alpspitze/Wetterstein, Zugspitze via Reintal) with official ski-touring routes.
comments: Zugspitzplatt still marketed and operated as the 'Zugspitze glacier ski area' (20 km, plateau 2600 m, Schneeferner) with lift-served glacier remnant; Garmisch-Classic (40 km, top 2050 m) is a separate area and separate day ticket (2025/26: Zugspitze 69; Classic 69 high/67 low; no combined 1-day ticket, only 2-day Twin Ticket). 2026/27 winter rates not yet published. Garmisch-Classic opens mid-December (2025/26 tickets from 13 Dec 2025; 2026/27 end 29.03.2027). Elevation 2650 from skiresort.com (Zugspitze). Base = Zugspitzbahnhof Garmisch (cogwheel to the Platt; Eibsee cable car alternative).

score_notes: Good but less-known off-piste (Gondrans bowls, Rocher de l'Aigle, Chalvet north side) inside the 400 km Vialattea; solid local touring (Chaberton, Gondrans) with the renowned Claree valley (Nevache) 20 min away.
comments: 2026/27 peak price 19 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027 (shoulder 45.50); Montgenèvre + Monts de la Lune pass 58.50; Voie Lactee international pass valid 19 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027; 2025/26 day pass was 52 EUR; resort sits on Col de Montgenevre (N94/SS24), open all year from Italy; local top lift point 2648 m (Via Lattea max 2823 m).

score_notes: Tiny lift area (4 lifts) but Austria's classic high-alpine touring base: Venter Skirunde multi-day hut tour, Wildspitze, Similaun, Weisskugel, local guide office.
comments: Included for ski touring (criterion 3). Single fixed 1-day price 51 EUR (2025/26). Road Soelden-Vent open in winter (temporary avalanche closures possible); Timmelsjoch closed. Elevation from skiresort.com. Base = Wildspitze double chair valley station in Vent (OSM). Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-19, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted. Milan route forced via Ötztal Bahnhof to avoid closed Timmelsjoch.

score_notes: Sunny plateau resort of the Sybelles, mostly groomed intermediate terrain with a few freeride zones and no competition history; touring limited to local summits (Tete de Bellard, Ouillon) with better classics reached from Saint-Sorlin.
comments: Same Sybelles pass and dates as Le Corbier; single fixed day price (59.30 in 2025/26, 60.50 in 2026/27); skiresort km used as no official km figure found; access from Italy via Frejus tunnel and A43.

score_notes: Family-oriented linked domain with marked freeride zones but no FWT/FWQ history or documented off-piste classics; touring interest lies on the Saint-Sorlin side (Aiguilles d'Arves), little from Le Corbier itself.
comments: Single fixed day price all season (59.30 in 2025/26, 60.50 in 2026/27) plus 30 EUR Saturday web promo and -10% from 21 Mar; no official km figure found so skiresort 275 km used (resort markets a higher figure); 2026/27 season 12 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027; access from Italy via Frejus tunnel and A43, no pass.

score_notes: Small village sector (La Chal, Charvin Express) feeding the Sybelles link, mostly groomed terrain with no freeride pedigree; touring shares the Arves valley classics but starts are better from Saint-Sorlin.
comments: Ski base is the hamlet of La Chal (1600 m), not the lower village; same Sybelles pass, dates and fixed day price as Le Corbier (sja73.com lists 1 jour 60.50 for 12 Dec 2026-9 Apr 2027); skiresort km used.

score_notes: Highest and steepest Sybelles sector (Les Perrons 2620 m) with the domain's best lift-served off-piste; genuine touring base for Aiguilles d'Arves, Etendard and Col de la Croix de Fer classics, though no big guide scene.
comments: Village base at Plan du Moulin Express bottom station (1500 m); Col de la Croix de Fer and Col du Glandon closed in winter (dead end above the village); same Sybelles pass, dates and fixed day price as Le Corbier; skiresort km used.

score_notes: Guidebook freeride destination: Marquise, Fogliettaz, Le Monal and Shaper's Paradise off-piste plus 3 marked Natur' runs; touring towards Le Monal/Ruitor is decent.
comments: Small area (6 lifts, 26 runs) included for freeride reputation; 2026/27 adult day 40 EUR per skiinfo listing (official shop is JS-only; skiresort 40.50 EUR); skiinfo lists 5 Dec 2026 opening vs official 12 Dec 2026; base = Sainte-Foy station (Bonconseil); 2025/26 date is the official planned date, actual not separately confirmed Milan route forced via Albertville to avoid closed Petit Saint-Bernard.

score_notes: Snow-sure Mercantour bowls with some off-piste (Pelevos, Sistron) but no FWQ pedigree; touring toward Col de la Lombarde/Mercantour is decent but limited.
comments: Continuous opening 6 Dec 2025-19 Apr 2026 after the 29-30 Nov pre-opening; official 2025/26 day price 44 EUR (card extra, insurance 3.50), 2026/27 price not published; Col de la Lombarde (from Vinadio) closed in winter, so from Italy via Ventimiglia-Nice-Tinee valley or the Col de Tende tunnel. Milan route forced via Nice to avoid closed Lombarde.

score_notes: Wide sunny bowls with modest off-piste and no competition history; Haut-Verdon/Mercantour touring is decent but limited in variety.
comments: Partial pre-opening 6-7 Dec 2025 announced by Allos town hall, not independently confirmed as held (continuous 13 Dec 2025); 2026/27 day pass 51 EUR (+3 EUR card); top 2600 m = Espace Lumiere high point at La Foux (alti-mag says 2570 m); Col d'Allos (D908) and Col de la Cayolle closed in winter, so no direct road from Barcelonnette/Italy - access via Digne-les-Bains/Colmars (long detour); Espace Lumiere link can stay shut early season. Milan route forced via Nice to avoid closed Allos.

score_notes: Sedrun side (Cuolm Val, Schneehueenerstock, Oberalp) offers good but moderate lift-accessed off-piste, the serious freeriding is on Gemsstock at the other end of the pass; touring is strong around the Oberalp pass (Piz Badus, Pazolastock, Maighels hut, Val Maighels/Val Cornera classics) with reliable snow.
comments: Same SkiArena pass and dynamic pricing as Andermatt (CHF 89 skiresort.com main-season figure). 2025/26 first ski day for the Sedrun sector not found - verify. Access from Milan: Oberalp and Lukmanier passes closed in winter - route via San Bernardino-Chur-Reichenau-Ilanz-Disentis-Sedrun; Andermatt-Sedrun Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn car train exists but not counted. Base = Dieni (gondola Dieni-Milez valley station next to Dieni railway station, car park). 2026/27 date is a resort-supplied season entry on an aggregator (skiresort.com/bergfex); no operator publication found and no 2025/26 date available. Milan route forced via Chur to avoid closed Oberalp.

score_notes: Family resort with modest off-piste (Mottet, Lauziere side); the Lauziere massif above Celliers is a classic Savoie touring area.
comments: Pre-opening 13-14 Dec 2025 (20 EUR, weather-dependent) was planned but not verified; Valmorel-only pass 56.10 EUR (2026/27) covers Valmorel/Doucy/Celliers/Le Pre but its km is not published, so Grand Domaine 165 km / 59.70 EUR used; Saturday -50%, Sunday -30%; 2026/27 opening 18 Dec is a Friday; Col de la Madeleine closed in winter

score_notes: North-north-east facing area that promotes secured off-piste inside the domain (Fontagnoux, Chaudannes) and holds snow well, but small and little known; touring possible above 2000 m yet with little variety.
comments: Car-free resort at 1600 m above Montricher-Albanne, park at the resort entrance; 2025/26 adult day 35.00; official top 2520 m (skiresort 2482 m); official km given as 60 km groomed (one English page says 65 km); cheapest day pass in the batch.

score_notes: Freeride Junior/FWQ venue with good high off-piste but small area; rubric anchor 4.0 for touring (Sellrain/Stubai Alps classics: Sulzkogel, Zwoelferkogel, Pirchkogel from the village).
comments: Fixed season pricing 2026/27: peak (19.12-6.1, 30.1-26.2) 66.50, regular 63, low 50.50; 1-day ticket is Kuehtai-only, Kuehtai-Hochoetz (>90 km) only from 2-day passes. Austria's highest village (2020 m); Kuehtai saddle road from Oetz/Sellrain open in winter. skiresort.com measures 49.8 km. skiinfo lists 28 Nov 2026 vs official 27 Nov.

score_notes: Seceda, Dantercepies and Ciampinoi off-piste plus Val Mesdi/Val Lasties via Pordoi; Puez-Odle and Sella groups offer many documented Dolomites day tours with strong guide offices in Selva/Ortisei; no FWT history.
comments: 2025/26 valley 1-day adult EUR 72 low / 80 high (official); DSS 2026/27 whole-area price published (EUR 80/89), valley prices pending; 2026/27 lifts and Sellaronda open 4 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027; base = Selva (Ciampinoi/Dantercepies), alternative Ortisei; from Milan via A22 Chiusa (no pass), Passo Sella/Gardena may close in heavy snow.

score_notes: Col Margherita (2513 m) has a marked freeride zone and off-piste towards Fuciade; Costabella, Monzoni, Bocche and Lagorai give good documented day tours but the area is small.
comments: Two unlinked sectors: Alpe Lusia (Ronchi/Moena and Bellamonte; base used here) and San Pellegrino-Falcade (pass at 46.36726, 11.80237), joined by free Tre Valli shuttle 20 Dec-15 Mar; Alpe Lusia is also included in the Fiemme-Obereggen valley pass; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 64 low / 71 high; fassa.com lists both skiareas 'open 4 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027' (generic note) and skiresort lists 28 Nov 2026; Passo San Pellegrino road open in winter; the 29 Nov 2025 opening is the announced date, not confirmed post hoc.

score_notes: Long groomed valley runs (Trametsch) with limited off-piste; modest touring around Plose/Peitlerkofel; no freeride reputation.
comments: INCLUSION UNDER REVIEW: local Plose area only ~42 km (7 lifts), below the 60 km basis; the DSS valley pass Rio Pusteria-Bressanone also covers Gitschberg Jochtal ~30 km away (not lift-linked); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 63 low / 70 high, 2026/27 list 'to be published shortly'; season 5 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027; base = Sant'Andrea/St. Andrae cable-car valley station above Bressanone. Included as a Dolomiti Superski valley area named in the brief although the Plose-only pass covers ~42 km (below the 60 km threshold).

score_notes: Off-piste limited to Groste/Spinale bowls and guided Brenta couloirs, no FWT history; Brenta Dolomites give classic but not very varied day tours (Bocca di Brenta, Val d'Agola, Cima Roma).
comments: Pre-opening 22-23 Nov 2025 at Groste announced by APT but not confirmed post hoc (official opening 28 Nov 2025; Pinzolo and Folgarida-Marilleva sectors 4 Dec); 2025/26 Skiarea 1-day adult EUR 74 low / 85 high (max window price), online prices dynamic (ski.it); 'Numero Ideale' skier cap on peak days; 2026/27 season validity from 28 Nov 2026 per ski.it sales conditions (skiresort lists 21 Nov 2026); no pass on route from Milan (A4/A22 or Val Rendena via Tione).

score_notes: Mostly groomed intermediate terrain with some tree skiing off Monte Vigo; Val di Sole touring (Val Meledrio, Peller, Presanella approaches) is modest in variety.
comments: Val di Sole bases: Folgarida gondola (used here), Marilleva 1400 (46.30243, 10.81015) and Daolasa/Commezzadura gondola; same Skiarea pass as Campiglio (dynamic online pricing); sector opened 4 Dec 2025 while Campiglio opened 28 Nov; no pass on Milan route (A22 or SS42 Tonale).

score_notes: Doss del Sabion is a piste-oriented sector with only tree-run off-piste; touring on the Adamello-Presanella side (Val Genova, Val Nambrone) is decent but less developed than Campiglio's Brenta side.
comments: Pinzolo sector (Doss del Sabion 2100 m) linked to Campiglio by gondola; Pinzolo-only 1-day pass 2025/26 EUR 59 low / 65 high also sold; Skiarea pass EUR 85 high with dynamic online pricing; skiresort lists Skiarea season from 21 Nov 2026 (Campiglio sector); base = Pinzolo village, Pinzolo-Pra Rodont gondola at south end.

score_notes: Sunny bowls with some off-piste (Costebelle, Peguieou) but no freeride events; Ubaye touring is pleasant but less extensive than Queyras or Ecrins.
comments: Pre-opening 6-7 Dec 2025 (Clappe telemix, Peguieou chair, 9 runs) was announced with 60 cm fresh snow but not independently confirmed as held; 2026/27 PraLoup Flex day pass 51 EUR non-dated (early-bird online 'Prems' from 35.70, dynamic; card 3 EUR); Espace Lumiere top 2600 m at La Foux, Pra Loup top 2503 m official (alti-mag 2570); link to La Foux weather-dependent; from Italy via Col de Larche/Maddalena (SS21/D900, usually open) to Barcelonnette.

score_notes: Gers bowl, Désert de Platé and Grandes Platières off-piste are well known; touring mostly Platé plateau/Tête Pelouse day tours.
comments: Base = Flaine Forum/Front de Neige car parks (via Cluses, A40; from Italy via Mont Blanc tunnel). 2025/26 pre-opening 29-30 Nov 2025 (Aup de Véran sector), official 6 Dec 2025-19 Apr 2026. 2026/27: 5 Dec 2026-18 Apr 2027 (5-18 Dec subject to snow). Local Flaine-only pass 60.70 EUR (2026/27); Grand Massif 63 EUR (+2 EUR keycard). Top: official 2500 m (Grandes Platières), skiresort.com 2480 m.

score_notes: Gentle plateau resort with limited lift-served off-piste; the Devoluy massif (Obiou, Pic de Bure, Grand Ferrand) has many classic day tours documented on Camptocamp.
