comments: Price from skiinfo 2025/26 (adult 18-69, +2 EUR card, updated Oct 2025) cross-checked with skiresort; official shop (ledevoluy.skiperformance.com) is a JS app not readable; two bases marketed as one destination, Superdevoluy village used as base; access via Gap or Col du Festre (D937, kept open in winter). Milan route forced via Gap to avoid closed Noyer.

score_notes: Tree-lined intermediate area with some off-piste towards Gers/Tête des Saix; modest local touring.
comments: Base = Kédeuze gondola in the village. 2025/26 planned opening 13 Dec 2025 (Grand Massif general opening) to 12 Apr 2026; actual first day not separately verified. 2026/27: 12 Dec 2026 (official). Villages pass (Carroz/Morillon/Samoëns/Sixt) 58.50 EUR 2026/27, km not published; 2500 m top is in Flaine (Grandes Platières).

score_notes: Gentle sunny terrain; some Lauziere/Cheval Noir touring nearby but limited variety and no freeride reputation.
comments: 2026/27 SFL adult day 53 EUR window / 51.50 EUR web; Grand Domaine day 59.70 EUR with link to Valmorel from 18 Dec 2026; -50% opening week 12-18 Dec 2026; 2025/26 date is the planned date from France Montagnes (SFL opened a week before the Grand Domaine link on 20 Dec); Col de la Madeleine closed in winter (access from Maurienne/La Chambre)

score_notes: Off-piste towards Gers/Vernant; Haut-Giffre and Sixt-Fer-à-Cheval touring (Criou, Col de Joux Plane) give good local touring.
comments: Base = Grand Massif Express gondola at Vercland (700 m), 2 km from the village; Sixt-Fer-à-Cheval is a linked village. Col de Joux Plane (to Morzine) closed in winter. 2026/27: alti-mag lists 19 Dec 2026 but Les Carroz (same lift company) publishes 12 Dec 2026 - double-check. Villages pass 58.50 EUR (2026/27), km not published. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-19, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Gentle family sector (Morillon 1100, Coulouvrier 2120 m); little off-piste or touring of note.
comments: Base = Morillon village gondola (700 m) to Morillon 1100. Sector top 2120 m (Coulouvrier chair); 2500 m is the Grand Massif top in Flaine. 2025/26 planned 20 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026, actual not separately verified. 2026/27 alti-mag provisional 19 Dec 2026 (Les Carroz official 12 Dec). Villages pass 58.50 EUR. Official morillon.fr redirects to haut-giffre.fr (certificate error), so the Grand Massif multi-cam page is used for the webcam. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-19, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Decent lift-accessed off-piste around Gerlos/Königsleiten (Isskogel, Übergangsjoch bowls) but no contest history or guiding scene of note; touring limited to moderate day tours from Gerlos (Kreuzjoch, Salzachgeier, Wildgerlostal).
comments: Base = Isskogelbahn valley station (Dorfbahn Gerlos alternative); 2025/26 Gerlos lifts opened 05.12.2025; 2026/27 official Isskogelbahn/Dorfbahn 04.12.2026-11.04.2027; Gerlos Alpine Road B165 (toll) open in winter; fixed price 82 EUR, 2+ days = Zillertaler Superskipass; from Italy via Brenner.

score_notes: Decent lift-accessed off-piste around Gerlos/Königsleiten (Isskogel, Übergangsjoch bowls) but no contest history or guiding scene of note; touring limited to moderate day tours from Gerlos (Kreuzjoch, Salzachgeier, Wildgerlostal).
comments: Base = Dorfbahn Königsleiten valley station (Wald im Pinzgau, Salzburg); 2025/26 opened 05.12.2025; 2026/27 official 04.12.2026-11.04.2027; access from Zillertal over Gerlos Alpine Road B165 (toll, open in winter) or from Mittersill (Felbertauern tunnel, toll); fixed price 82 EUR; incl. Hochkrimml lifts.

score_notes: Harakiri 78% piste and Penken/Rastkogel off-piste with local freeride guiding (skiresort 'top for freeriders'); Mayrhofen is the gateway for Zillertal Alps spring touring (Berliner Hütte, Schwarzenstein) and Tuxer Voralpen day tours.
comments: Fixed price: 1-day adult 79 EUR in 2025/26, 82 EUR (from 08:00) in 2026/27; Mayrhofen pass max 1.5 days, 2+ days only as Zillertaler Superskipass; 2025/26 Horberg+Penken opened 05.12.2025, Ahorn 13.12.2025; 2026/27 Ahorn from 12.12.2026; +2 EUR keycard deposit; from Italy via Brenner, no pass closures.

score_notes: Decent lift-accessed off-piste around Gerlos/Königsleiten (Isskogel, Übergangsjoch bowls) but no contest history or guiding scene of note; touring limited to moderate day tours from Gerlos (Kreuzjoch, Salzachgeier, Wildgerlostal).
comments: 2025/26 area opened 05.12.2025 (Karspitzbahn Zell, Gerlos, Königsleiten); Rosenalmbahn Zell reopened 12.12.2025 after modernisation; 2026/27 official start 04.12.2026 for all valley lifts (skiinfo aggregator lists 05.12/12.12.2026 - conflict, official used); fixed price, 1-day from 08:00 82 EUR, 2+ days = Zillertaler Superskipass; from Italy via Brenner, no pass closures.

score_notes: No FWT/FWQ history and a piste-oriented region, but real off-piste at First (Baergelegg/Schwarzhorn side) and Eigergletscher-Wixi; touring per rubric example: Jungfraujoch railway gives access to Moench/Jungfrau/Loetschenluecke-Konkordia glacier classics plus Faulhorn/Schwarzhorn day tours, strong guide scene (Grindelwald Sports/Bergsteigerzentrum).
comments: Fixed prices, no dynamic pricing: 2025/26 day pass CHF 79 regular, CHF 83 high season (20.12.2025-04.01.2026 and 31.01-01.03.2026); 2026/27 pass published as from CHF 79, high-season surcharge not yet published; season 21.11.2026-25.04.2027. 2025/26: planned weekend start Kleine Scheidegg 15.11.2025 snow permitting (not confirmed), continuous operation from 29.11.2025, Maennlichen 13.12, First 20.12.2025. Max elevation 2500 m = First/Oberjoch per skiresort.com (Kleine Scheidegg-Maennlichen sector 2400 m). Base = Grindelwald Terminal (Eiger Express/Maennlichen gondolas, car park). Route from Milan via Simplon or Gotthard-Interlaken, no winter pass closure on route. Milan route forced via Lucerne to avoid closed Susten.

score_notes: Good lift-served off-piste (Col du Joly, Aiguille Croche, Nant Rouge); strong touring (Dômes de Miage, Tré-la-Tête, Col de la Fenêtre) inside the nature reserve with an active guide office.
comments: Base = Télécabine du Lay (main car park); Télécabine de la Gorge is the second base (works summer 2026). 2025/26: partial 6-7 Dec and 13-19 Dec, general 20 Dec 2025-12 Apr 2026. 2026/27: partial 5-6 Dec and 12-18 Dec, general 19 Dec 2026-10 Apr 2027. Elevation: lift-co states 1164-2500 m, bergfex 2487 m, skiresort.com 2437 m. Also on the Evasion Mont-Blanc pass (65 EUR 2026/27). Route via Mont Blanc tunnel-Saint-Gervais.

score_notes: Balme sector hosted FWQ freeride events; Combe de Borderan/Fernuy off-piste; Aravis touring classics (Pointe Percée, Trou de la Mouche, Combe des Aravis).
comments: Base = Bossonnet lift and car park in the village. From Italy via Mont Blanc tunnel-Sallanches-Col des Aravis (normally kept open, may close in heavy snow) or A41 Annecy. Dynamic pricing: Prem's online 29.90-49.90 EUR (49.90 = max, bought 2+ days ahead) vs 56.50 EUR window price (2025/26 tariff still displayed; 2026/27 not yet online). 2025/26 pre-openings 29-30 Nov (Balme) and 6-7 Dec; continuous 13 Dec 2025-26 Apr 2026. Elevation: skiresort.com 2485 m; official/aggregators quote 2500-2600 m. Manigod on same pass.

score_notes: Sella/Pordoi classics (Val Lasties, Forcella Pordoi, Val Mesdi via Pordoi cable car) and Ciampac/Belvedere off-piste with local guides; dense Gulliver route coverage on Sella, Catinaccio, Marmolada and Monzoni.
comments: Valley pass covers Belvedere/Col Rodella, Buffaure/Ciampac, Catinaccio and Carezza only (Alpe Lusia and San Pellegrino are a separate DSS zone); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 68 low / 76 high (high 21 Dec-10 Jan, 1 Feb-21 Mar); DSS 2026/27 whole-area price published (EUR 80/89) but valley prices not yet; new 3S Col Rodella opened Christmas 2025; Carezza sector opened 6 Dec 2025; skiresort quotes ~109 km; from Milan via A22 Ora-Val di Fiemme (no pass), Passo Fedaia/Pordoi/Sella subject to winter closures.

score_notes: Mainly on-piste with some off-piste under Las Donnas and no freeride events; Mercantour/Tinee touring is decent but modest.
comments: Official day-price page shows 44 EUR but without a season label (skiinfo: 44 EUR for 2025/26, +2 EUR card; 2026/27 price not confirmed); Col de la Lombarde closed in winter, so from Italy via Ventimiglia-Nice-Tinee valley (M2205) or the Col de Tende tunnel; base = Auron village (Las Donnas cable car). Milan route forced via Nice to avoid closed Lombarde.

score_notes: Family/intermediate area with only minor off-piste below Glogghues/Planplatten and no freeride event history; local touring is modest (Hasliberg ridges), the Haslital classics (Rosenlaui, Gadmen/Susten) lie outside the resort.
comments: Fixed price: adult 1-day CHF 65 (official 2025/26 tariff table still online); Magic Pass member since May 2025. 2026/27: continuous operation Sat 19.12.2026-29.03.2027, weekend operation from November possible snow permitting. Base = Hasliberg Twing/Wasserwendi (Kaeserstatt gondola, company HQ, car park); alternative base Meiringen (aerial cableway to Reuti). Route from Milan via Gotthard-Bruenig or Interlaken; Grimsel and Susten passes closed in winter (not required). Milan route forced via Lucerne to avoid closed Susten.

score_notes: Hochjoch sector is the gentler half of Silvretta Montafon (family/on-piste), some off-piste bowls; touring in Verwall/Raetikon moderate.
comments: Dynamic pricing (season phase, weekday, demand, booking time); 77 = skiresort.com listed 2025/26 day ticket, peak online price may differ; 2026/27 prices only in web shop. Hochjoch Bahn itself runs 19 Dec-4 Apr; early season via Zamang Bahn. 2025/26 actual opening not found. Base = Hochjochbahn valley station, Schruns. skiinfo lists 21 Nov 2026 vs official 27 Nov.

score_notes: Nova sector hosted Open Faces FWQ events and has the steep Hochalpila/Nova Stoba freeride terrain and strong local freeride scene; touring moderate (Verwall/Silvretta access via Bielerhoehe closed).
comments: Same lift company and day pass as row 127 (dynamic pricing; 77 = skiresort.com 2025/26 listing). Base = Valisera Bahn valley station, St. Gallenkirch (alternative Versettla Bahn, Gaschurn 46.98501/10.02554). Silvretta-Hochalpenstrasse closed in winter. 2025/26 actual opening not found.

score_notes: Marked but ungroomed 'Freeski' itineraries (Vallons du Pra, Combe de Bedina couloirs) and self-described largest freeride area around Grenoble; Belledonne touring (Refuge de la Pra, marked ascent route Les Fanges) with many documented day tours but modest altitude.
comments: Dynamic pricing online (0-10% off day and 4-hour passes); 2026/27 grid: high season (weekends, holidays, school breaks) adult day 45, low season Mon-Fri 42; base = Prapoutel (Gresivaudan side), Le Pleynet (Haut-Breda via Allevard) is an alternative base; 2025/26: 2 lifts at Pipay from 27 Nov 2025 then weekend openings, full season from 20 Dec 2025; top elevation from skiresort (official site gives no figure); official 26/27 dates not yet online. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-19, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Small Ubaye resort, mostly on-piste with some steep local off-piste and no events; limited touring on the Chapeau de Gendarme / Grande Seolane sides.
comments: 13-14 Dec 2025 weekend opening reported only by skiinfo, continuous opening 20 Dec 2025 per press (use 20 Dec if in doubt); 2026/27 single day price 39 EUR (season 19 Dec 2026-29 Mar 2027); base = Le Sauze 1400 (Super Sauze 1700 is the upper village); from Italy via Col de Larche to Barcelonnette (4 km).

score_notes: Mainly on-piste intermediate terrain (Lauberhorn/Maennlichen), limited off-piste around Wixi-Fallboden and Eigergletscher, no freeride event history; touring benefits from the Jungfraujoch railway (Moench, Loetschenluecke, Konkordia) and Lauterbrunnen-valley tours but the guide scene sits in Grindelwald/Lauterbrunnen.
comments: Car-free village: road head Lauterbrunnen (multi-storey car park at the station, then WAB rack railway to Wengen). Same Jungfrau Ski Region pass and fixed prices as Grindelwald (CHF 79 regular / 83 high season 2025/26; 2026/27 from CHF 79). Max elevation 2400 m per skiresort.com, not confirmed on official site. Season 2026/27 21.11.2026-25.04.2027. Milan route forced via Lucerne to avoid closed Susten.

score_notes: Sunny intermediate pistes with some bowl/tree off-piste at Haideralm; Reschenpass, Langtaufers and Sesvenna valleys are well-known touring grounds with many documented routes.
comments: 2026/27 published: season 5 Dec 2026-3 Apr 2027, 1-day adult EUR 70 window / 68 online valid 19 Dec 2026-3 Apr 2027 (pre-season 5-18 Dec priced separately); official webcam page is an empty JS shell so bergfex multi-cam used; two sectors Belpiano/Schoeneben (Resia, base used here) and Malga San Valentino/Haideralm linked by lift; Passo Resia open year-round; from Milan via Val Venosta (Merano) or Switzerland/Austria.

score_notes: Piste-focused family sectors (Cermis, Latemar) with only modest off-piste at Pampeago/Cermis; Lagorai and Latemar have many documented ski tours and an active local touring scene but no high-alpine classics.
comments: Valley pass covers Alpe Cermis (Cavalese, base used here), Latemar Dolomites (Obereggen-Pampeago-Predazzo, top ~2388 m), Bellamonte-Alpe Lusia, Passo Rolle and Oclini; sectors linked only by skibus except Latemar; 2026/27: first lifts Obereggen 27 Nov 2026, Fiemme link 28 Nov, season to 4 Apr 2027; night skiing Obereggen Tue/Fri; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 64 low / 71 high; alternative base Obereggen 46.38500, 11.52597.

score_notes: Hochfügen's high basin is a well-known Tyrolean freeride spot (skiresort: 'paradise for freeriders', untouched slopes into spring); Tuxer Voralpen give popular but moderate day tours (Gilfert, Rastkogel).
comments: 2025/26: Hochfügen weekend ops 22-23 and 29-30.11.2025, Kaltenbach weekend 29-30.11.2025, continuous daily ops from 05.12.2025; 2026/27 continuous ops published 05.12.2026-11.04.2027 (earlier weekend openings possible, not published); price is full-day ticket from 07:30, no seasonal split, 1 EUR less with guest card; official highest point 'almost 2,400 m' (skiresort 2378 m); from Italy via Brenner, no pass closures.

score_notes: Tognola/Colverde off-piste, Rosetta cable-car descents and Passo Rolle freeride; Pale di San Martino and Lagorai are among Trentino's best-documented touring grounds (Passo Rolle classics, Val Venegia) with an active guide office.
comments: Official 2025/26 price list: 1-day adult EUR 63 (29 Nov-20 Dec, 11-31 Jan, from 15 Mar) / 70 (21 Dec-10 Jan, 1 Feb-14 Mar); pre-opening weekend ticket EUR 31.50; two sectors (San Martino, Passo Rolle) linked by skibus, lift link planned; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 28 Nov 2026-11 Apr 2027 (unverified); base = Tognola gondola car park; Passo Rolle open in winter (chains may be required).

score_notes: Mainly groomed-piste resort; limited off-piste at Cote 2000/Mont Joly; modest local touring (Mont Joly, Aiguille Croche).
comments: Base = Rochebrune cable car and car park. Route via Mont Blanc tunnel-Sallanches. 2025/26: exceptional Cote 2000 opening 29-30 Nov 2025 (25 EUR day), Mont d'Arbois 8-12 Dec, general 20 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026. 2026/27: partial 5-6 Dec (Cote 2000, Mont d'Arbois), general 19 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027. Price = Evasion Mont-Blanc 1-day haute saison 2026/27 (65 EUR; 12-18 Dec 52 EUR) as published by the Saint-Gervais and Portes du Mont-Blanc lift-co sites; Megève 2025/26 PDF was 63.50. Top 2353 m = Mont Joly (Saint-Gervais sector), Megève's own sectors are lower; bergfex quotes 1113-2350 m and Evasion 445 km.

score_notes: Mont Joly/Epaule offers some off-piste; touring modest (Mont Joly, Col du Joly); no guide-culture hub.
comments: Base = Le Bettex (1400 m) gondola station and car park (incl. Saint-Nicolas-de-Véroce sector); alternative valley gondola Saint-Gervais-Le Bettex from town. 2025/26 partial 13-19 Dec then general 20 Dec 2025 (year not printed on lift-co page; matches 2025 calendar and SMB listing 13 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026). 2026/27 Evasion tariff: intermediate period 12-18 Dec 2026 (52 EUR) then haute saison from 19 Dec (65 EUR); alti-mag lists 19 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027. Les Houches-Saint-Gervais (Prarion/Bellevue) is a separate Chamonix-side area not on this pass. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-19, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Open Faces FWQ venue and Innsbruck's freeride hotspot (steep Hoadl/Pleisen/Birgitzkoepfl faces, Kalkkoegel backdrop); touring in Kalkkoegel/Stubai Alps decent but limited variety. Calibrated to 3.5 (small area).
comments: 2026/27 opening not clearly published: official site lists Hoadl-Haus winter opening 20 Nov and Ski Opening event 27 Nov 2026; skinachrichten.de says 21 Nov 2026, skiinfo.de 21 Dec 2026. 2025/26 fixed prices: high season (20.12.25-22.03.26) 63, pre/late 56.50; 2026/27 winter tariffs not yet online. Base = Hoadlbahn valley station car park (1560 m).

score_notes: High snow-sure bowl (1,630-2,313 m) with well-known off-piste between lifts and the 45-degree Gamsleiten 2, but limited vertical; the Radstaedter Tauern around Obertauern is a popular, well-documented ski-touring region (Seekarspitze, Zehnerkar, Hundskogel).
comments: Fixed pricing (no dynamic pricing): 2026/27 adult 1-day 72.00 EUR in both Season A (26.12.2026-08.01.2027, 23.01.-02.04.2027) and Season B (20.11.-25.12.2026, 09.01.-22.01.2027, 03.04.-02.05.2027); from 1.5 days also valid in Grosseck-Speiereck. 2025/26 started 21 Nov 2025 in limited form (valley runs from 22 Nov). Base = village centre (car park at the lifts, 1,740 m). Resort lies on the Radstaedter Tauern pass road, kept open in winter; from Italy via A10 Tauern motorway (Katschberg tunnel) or B99 Katschberg pass (open). Piste km from skiresort.com.

score_notes: Sunny, mostly gentle groomed terrain with only short tree-line off-piste and no freeride event history; touring is modest (Piz Mundaun, Piz Sezner, Val Lumnezia easy tours).
comments: Fixed prices: official winter tariff page lists adult day ticket CHF 67 (half-day tiers CHF 65/61/54/48); the table is undated but sits next to 2026/27 season-pass offers (skiresort.com also 67; skiinfo 2024/25 65) - treat as 2026/27. 2025/26 first ski day not found (press 24.12.2025 reported thin snow at mid-altitude Graubuenden resorts) - verify. Base = Meierhof (Obersaxen) valley station, car park; alternative bases Valata and Vella. Route from Milan via San Bernardino-Chur-Ilanz-Obersaxen, no pass closure. 2026/27 date is a resort-supplied season entry on an aggregator (skiresort.com/bergfex); no operator publication found and no 2025/26 date available. Milan route forced via Mesocco to avoid closed Lukmanier.

score_notes: Pierra Menta ski-mountaineering race host and Beaufortain touring hub with a dense route network; freeride: Grand Mont marked ungroomed runs, called a benchmark freeride destination by the OT, but lift-served terrain is small.
comments: Pre-opening weekend 13-14 Dec 2025 was planned but not verified - official continuous opening 20 Dec 2025 used; 2026/27 pre-openings possible 5-6 and 12-13 Dec 2026; day pass 41 EUR window, web promo from 24.70 EUR (dynamic pricing); top altitude 2300 m from skiresort (official text unreadable); second base Le Planay (45.67197, 6.54032); Cormet de Roselend closed in winter

score_notes: Renowned freeride/touring village: Nidla freeride run, Madrisa terrain, venue of 2027 FIS Freestyle/Freeski Worlds events; Madrisa-Rundtour (border tour to Klosters) and Raetikon day tours with local guides. Calibrated to 3.5 (village-scale area).
comments: Dynamic pricing, regular 1-day price not published (web shop only); static 2026/27 group rate (21-40 pax) 63.10 gives a lower bound. Multi-day WildPass Montafon covers Silvretta Montafon, Golm etc. 2025/26 actual opening not found. Base = Schafbergbahn valley station car park, Gargellen (1423 m), end of the Gargellen valley road. Elevation/km from skiresort.com. No published fixed day-pass price: Montafon-Brandnertal dynamic pricing (skiinfo 'from EUR 56' for 2025/26); peak price not published, left blank.

score_notes: Silvapark has dedicated freeride sectors but limited size; Galtuer is a classic Silvretta ski-touring base (Jamtalhuette, Piz Buin, Silvretta traverse, guide-led touring weeks). Calibrated to 4.0.
comments: Peak-season 1-day 58.50 EUR (19.12.26-11.04.27), low season 55.50 (4-18 Dec 2026). Silvretta-Hochalpenstrasse (Bielerhoehe) closed in winter, Galtuer is the road end of the Paznaun. Base = Birkhahnbahn valley station, Wirl (1635 m). Elevation/km from skiresort.com.

score_notes: Rounded piste mountain with little off-piste; ski touring mostly in nearby Antholz/Gsies valleys and Pragser Dolomites, which have many documented routes.
comments: Bases Riscone/Brunico (used here), Valdaora and San Vigilio; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 72 low / 80 high; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 28 Nov 2026-11 Apr 2027 (not verified on official site, which still shows summer); reached via A22 Bressanone-SS49 (no pass).

score_notes: Hauts Forts, Fornet and the Swiss Wall/Chavanette give strong lift-served off-piste; touring limited (resort-based).
comments: Car-free resort: drive to the paid entrance car parks at 1800 m (coordinates given) or park at Les Prodains (46.18893, 6.75595) and take the Prodains Express cable car. 2025/26: pre-opening 29-30 Nov and 6-7 Dec 2025, official 12 Dec 2025-19 Apr 2026. 2026/27: 11 Dec 2026-18 Apr 2027. Avoriaz-only pass 43-55 EUR (dynamic, 2026/27), km not published; Portes du Soleil 69 EUR online/73 desk until 19 Mar 2027 (+3 EUR card). Top: skiresort.com Portes du Soleil lift-served 2254 m; marketing quotes 2466 m (Hauts Forts summit). Access from Italy via Pas de Morgins or Geneva-Thonon.

ski_area: Portes du Soleil (Swiss side: Champéry–Les Crosets–Champoussin)
score_notes: Swiss Wall (Chavanette) and Les Crosets/Mossettes off-piste with local guiding but no major event history; touring around the Dents du Midi is decent yet not a hub.
comments: Base = Champéry–Planachaux cable car (Les Crosets/Champoussin reachable by road, higher up). Swiss side sells only the full Portes du Soleil day pass in CHF: skiinfo CHF 72 vs bergfex CHF 81 high season 2025/26 (conflicting); official shop showed only season passes. Official 2026/27: Crosets 8 lift from 28 Nov 2026, Champéry–Planachaux from 5 Dec 2026, whole area 19 Dec 2026, close 11 Apr 2027. PdS official opening 2025/26 was 20 Dec 2025; skiresort top 2254 m is for whole PdS (Swiss top Pointe des Mossettes not verified). From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon; Pas de Morgins open in winter.

score_notes: Mostly gentle on-piste terrain with some tree runs off La Foilleuse; limited local touring (Pointe de Bellevue, Corbeau).
comments: Morgins sector opens later than Les Crosets: official 2026/27 Morgins 12–13 Dec 2026 (whole PdS 19 Dec 2026, Morgins closes 4 Apr 2027). 2025/26: PdS official opening 20 Dec 2025 (Watson/Blick lists) but Morgins first lift day not found. Same full-PdS day pass as Champéry with conflicting aggregator prices (skiinfo 72 / bergfex 81). Base = La Foilleuse gondola. Pas de Morgins (to Châtel) open in winter; from Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

score_notes: Mainly on-piste Grenoble day-trip resort with limited off-piste (Casserousse, Lacs Robert sector); very popular local Belledonne touring with marked ascent routes but little variety or altitude.
comments: 2025/26: pre-opening weekend 29-30 Nov 2025 then continuous opening 6 Dec 2025-12 Apr 2026 (official); official 26/27 dates not yet online, skiresort shows 28 Nov 2026 while Parcs & Loisirs gives 5 Dec 2026; base = Recoin 1650/1750 (Croix de Chamrousse gondola); day-pass discount for online purchase; 2026/27 day price not yet published (ticketing SPA). Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-05, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Schlossalm-Angertal is broad, mostly on-piste terrain with modest side-country (the serious freeride is in Sportgastein, same ticket); Gastein valley tours (Angertal, Schlossalm piste tours, Tauern day tours) give a 3.5 for touring.
comments: Same Ski amade Gastein ticket and dynamic pricing as Bad Gastein: main season online 69.50-81.50 EUR, office 81.50 EUR. Max elevation = Stubnerkogel 2,246 m (lift-linked with Schlossalm 2,050 m via Angertal; skiresort.com lists 2,300 m for the linked area). Base = Schlossalmbahn valley station (bus terminal). No winter pass closure from Italy (A10 Tauern motorway or Tauernschleuse car train). Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Staller Sattel.

score_notes: Rotwand/Croda Rossa and Stiergarten offer moderate off-piste; Sexten Dolomites, Kreuzbergpass and Comelico provide many documented ski tours but a small guiding scene.
comments: Linked Helm-Stiergarten-Rotwand-Kreuzbergpass area is 86 km (skiresort), pass adds Haunold, Rienz, Prags and Padola sectors; base = Versciaco/Vierschach Helm gondola next to rail station (Sesto 46.67197, 12.38705 alternative); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 72 low / 80 high; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 27 Nov 2026-11 Apr 2027 (unverified); 2026/27 season pass published; via Val Pusteria SS49 (no pass).

score_notes: Good but limited off-piste on Ifen and Kanzelwand (north faces), no major event history; popular Allgaeu touring valley (Hoher Ifen, Widderstein, Walmendinger Horn) with guide offerings.
comments: Two-country day pass 2026/27 adult 72.90 (single published price; 2025/26 was 68.70). 2224 m = Nebelhorn (DE) on the same pass; Kleinwalsertal-side lifts top out lower (Kanzelwand 1967 m, Ifen slightly higher). Road access only via Oberstdorf (Germany), no road link to the rest of Vorarlberg. Base = Kanzelwandbahn valley station, Riezlern. 2025/26 actual opening not found.

score_notes: Nebelhorn's north-side terrain is the Allgaeu's best-known freeride spot but small; solid Allgaeu touring (Nebelhorn, Fellhorn ridge) without high-alpine variety.
comments: Two-country day pass 2026/27 adult 72.90 (single published price; 2025/26 68.70; Soellereck-only tickets cheaper). Nebelhorn (2224 m) opens 12 Dec 2026, Fellhorn 4 Dec, Soellereck 'as early as possible'. Base = Nebelhornbahn valley station in Oberstdorf town (Fellhornbahn 5 km south). 2025/26 actual opening not found.

score_notes: Mainly groomed family/intermediate resort with a few short off-piste variants below Leist/Maschgenkamm and no freeride event history; touring is decent locally (Spitzmeilen hut, Wissmilen, Magerrain tours from Tannenboden/Prodkamm) but limited variety.
comments: 2025/26: press headlines (Linth24 21.11.2025 'Flumserberg startet Wintersaison', Vaterland 20.11.2025 'Pizol und Flumserberg starten frueher') indicate a start on the weekend of 22.11.2025 (exact first day 21 or 22.11 - verify). 2026/27: official page says start is flexible, expected late November/early December, season ends 29.03.2027 (skiresort.com placeholder 16.11.2026 not used). Price CHF 74 = skiresort.com main-season adult figure (skiinfo 2024/25 listed 68); official tariff page loads prices dynamically - verify. SeeJet gondola (Unterterzen) closed for revision 30.03-11.06.2027. Base = Tannenboden (Tannenbodenalp, Maschgenkamm gondola, car parks; road open). Route from Milan via Gotthard-Zurich-A3 or San Bernardino-Chur-A13/A3; no pass closures.

road_head: Siusi (Seis) – Alpe di Siusi cable-car valley station
score_notes: Gentle high plateau with wide groomed pistes and negligible off-piste; some documented tours towards Sciliar/Denti di Terrarossa and Sassopiatto but limited variety.
comments: Road Siusi-Compatsch closed to private cars 09:00-17:00 while the cableway runs (permit holders/hotel guests excepted), so visitors park at the Siusi valley station (garage EUR 12/day, free outdoor lot); cableway 5 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027; standard pass is the Val Gardena-Alpe di Siusi valley pass (2025/26 EUR 72 low / 80 high), lift link to Val Gardena via Monte Pana/Saltria.

score_notes: Family resort with gentle Aineck/Tschaneck terrain and little serious off-piste; only a handful of local ski tours (Aineck, Tschaneck, Kareck).
comments: Fixed pricing, no dynamic pricing: 2026/27 adult 1-day 73.00 EUR all season (2025/26 was 69.50 EUR); season 04.12.2026-28.03.2027. 2025/26 first day: homepage stated 'ski area open from 2 Dec' (Tue) while the price sheet planned 5 Dec 2025 - coordinator may double-check. New 8-seater Almbahn from Dec 2025. Base = Katschberghoehe pass village (1,640 m) on the B99; the pass road and the adjacent A10 Katschberg tunnel are open all winter, so no closure from Italy (Tarvisio-Villach-A10).

score_notes: Linga north faces and Cornebois off-piste; valley touring to Mont de Grange/Cornettes de Bise.
comments: Base = Linga gondola car park (Route de Pré-la-Joux); Super-Châtel gondola in the village; La Chapelle-d'Abondance is a linked village on the same pass. From Italy via Grand-Saint-Bernard/Martigny-Monthey-Pas de Morgins (open in winter). 2025/26: partial from 6 Dec (Avoriaz pre-opening with Châtel link; bergfex), 13 Dec partial, 20 Dec total, closed 19 Apr 2026. 2026/27: partial 5-6 Dec and 12-18 Dec, total 19 Dec 2026-18 Apr 2027. Espace Liberté 55 EUR high season (47 off-peak/late season); Portes du Soleil 69 EUR; online rates lower than desk. Top 2200 m per skiinfo; bergfex quotes 2466 m (summit).

ski_area: Adelboden–Lenk (Chuenisbärgli/Silleren/Hahnenmoos/Metsch; pass incl. Betelberg, Engstligenalp, Elsigen-Metsch, Tschentenalp)
score_notes: World Cup piste resort, mostly groomed intermediate terrain with modest off-piste (Luegli, Hahnenmoos, Engstligenalp bowls) and no freeride event history; touring is good but local: Engstligenalp is a classic base (Wildstrubel, Ammertenspitz, Lohner), Sillerenbuehl/Hahnenmoos tours, Adelboden mountain-guide school.
comments: Dynamic pricing for day tickets since 2023/24 (official FAQ: the earlier you book the cheaper); no public price table for 2025/26 or 2026/27 found (webshop only, summer tariffs displayed in Sept) - price left blank, coordinator should check the webshop (peak window). 2025/26: official operating plan started 06.12.2025 (Sillerenbuehl/Metsch) but press (Nau 28.11.2025) reports an earlier opening for the weekend 29/30.11.2025 - verify exact first day. Day ticket 'Adelboden-Lenk incl. Frutigen' covers Adelboden-Lenk, Betelberg, Engstligenalp (top 2353 m), Elsigen-Metsch and Tschentenalp. AlpsPass season pass CHF 949 (2026/27). Base = Oey (Sillerenbahn valley station, car park). Route from Milan via Simplon-Loetschberg car train (Goppenstein-Kandersteg) or Bern-Frutigen; no pass closures. Milan route forced via Lucerne to avoid closed Susten.

score_notes: Metsch/Hahnenmoos and Betelberg are groomed family terrain with little steep off-piste and no freeride event history; touring from Lenk is a real plus (Iffigenalp-Wildhorn, Wildstrubel/Laemmerenhuette, Betelberg-Rothorn day tours) but with limited variety compared with hubs.
comments: Same lift company and dynamic pricing as Adelboden (no public 2025/26 or 2026/27 day-ticket price found - blank, check webshop). Same official 2025/26 plan (06.12.2025) and press-reported earlier weekend opening 29/30.11.2025 (Silleren/Metsch) - verify. Base = Metschbahn valley station Rotenbach (Lenk-Metsch gondola into the linked area, car park); Betelberg is a separate sector at Lenk village on the same pass. Route from Milan via Simplon-Loetschberg car train-Spiez-Zweisimmen or via Bern; no pass closures (Jaunpass open but not needed). Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Susten.

score_notes: FWQ 2026 venue with Tour d'Aï/Chaux de Mont off-piste and a strong freestyle scene; touring limited to Tour d'Aï, Chaux de Mont and Pic Chaussy.
comments: Official teleleysin.ch unreachable during research (timeouts), so all key figures are from skiresort/press; webcam via Leysin roundshot (redirects to Tobogganing Park cam). Lift company Leysin–Les Mosses–La Lécherette (TLML). Base = Berneuse gondola (Leysin-Feydey). Col des Mosses open in winter. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

ski_area: Gstaad Mountain Rides (Saanenland: Rinderberg-Saanersloch-Horneggli, Eggli-La Videmanette, Wispile, Wasserngrat)
score_notes: Low, gentle terrain (mostly below 2200 m) with limited off-piste (Videmanette, Wasserngrat) and no freeride event history; touring is pleasant but moderate: Wispile, Hornfluh, Lauenen/Wildhorn hut and Gsteig/Sanetsch tours, Glacier 3000 approaches, local guide offices.
comments: 2025/26: first lifts (Saanersloch-Hornberg) opened 28.11.2025, full operation reached by 20.12.2025; Glacier 3000 (Les Diablerets, 3016 m) opened 08.11.2025 but is NOT included in the 1-day Gstaad ticket (included in multi-day tickets, separate day ticket sold). Max elevation 2151 m = La Videmanette (Rougemont), Rinderberg/Saanersloch sector tops at 2011 m. Pricing: from 2026/27 day tickets have fixed seasonal prices (dynamic pricing dropped for day/half-day tickets, kept for multi-day); CHF 94 = skiresort.com main-season 2026/27 figure, official price table only inside the ticketcorner shop (2026/27 group day ticket CHF 76 for 10+ pax) - verify. Magic Pass partner since 2025/26. Base = Gstaad Eggli gondola valley station car park. Route from Milan via Simplon-Montreux-Col des Mosses or Bern-Zweisimmen; no winter pass closure. CHF 84 = 2025/26 peak-season fixed day ticket (Blick); CHF 94 = 2026/27 figure per skiresort.com (official table only in Ticketcorner).

score_notes: Family-oriented Kitzbuehel-Alps grass terrain with little committed off-piste; Neukirchen is a decent local touring base (Wildkogel touring routes, Habach/Untersulzbach valleys into the Venediger group) with limited variety.
comments: Single day price all winter (no high/low season, no dynamic pricing); 2026/27 season 05.12.2026-08.12.2026 and 11.12.2026-04.04.2027. 2025/26 start 5 Dec 2025 per official pre-season press (actual day not independently confirmed). Elevation/km cross-checked on skiresort.com. From Italy via Felbertauern tunnel (toll) or Gerlos Alpine Road (open in winter, toll).

score_notes: Mainly on-piste family terrain with limited off-piste (Chaux Ronde, Meilleret); modest touring (Chamossaire, Diablerets foothills).
comments: Dynamic pricing (TVGD: up to -50% online); skiresort main-season CHF 69; bergfex CHF 84 is likely the Alpes Vaudoises pass incl. Glacier 3000 (bergfex lists 1300–3000 m). 2025/26: five Bretaye pistes opened weekend 29–30 Nov 2025, full opening 5 Dec 2025. Col de la Croix (Villars–Les Diablerets road) closed in winter. Base = Villars Roc d'Orsay gondola. From Italy via Great St Bernard tunnel or Simplon.

score_notes: Lachat/Almet off-piste is limited; good Aravis touring access (Pointe Percée north side, Col des Annes, Pointe d'Almet).
comments: Base = Le Chinaillon (1300 m) ski-village car parks; village gondola (Rosay) lower. Col de la Colombière closed in winter (approach via Thônes/Saint-Jean-de-Sixt). 2025/26 dates (6-7 Dec weekend, continuous 13 Dec 2025-10 Apr 2026) are planned dates from aggregators, not separately verified. 2026/27: 12 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027; day pass 52 EUR (official 2026/27 tariff). Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-12, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted. Milan route forced via Albertville to avoid closed Colombière.

score_notes: Civetta north-side itineraries from Col dei Baldi/Fertazza and Zoldo tree runs are known locally with guide-led options; Civetta, Pelmo and Moiazza groups offer documented tours from Val di Zoldo but on a limited scale.
comments: skicivetta.com returned HTTP 403 to automated requests, so km/elevation from skiresort and prices from DSS press (2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 63 low / 70 high); Ski Civetta covers Alleghe (base used here), Selva di Cadore, Palafavera and Val di Zoldo (Pecol); skiresort lists 2026/27 season 28 Nov 2026-4 Apr 2027 (unverified); Passo Giau/Staulanza may close in winter; from Milan via Belluno-Agordo-Alleghe.

score_notes: Freeride World Tour stop (Wildseeloder face) and self-styled freeride capital of Austria with strong guiding/freeride-camp scene; touring only moderate Kitzbühel Alps day tours (Wildseeloder, Henne).
comments: 2025/26 Fieberbrunn lifts F1/F2 Streuböden, F4 Lärchfilzen, F6 Zillstatt ran from Skicircus opening day 28.11.2025 (season to 06.04.2026); 2026/27 planned 27.11.2026-04.04.2027; price = peak season 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 82 EUR, all tickets are Ski ALPIN CARD (also valid Schmitten Zell am See, Kitzsteinhorn/Maiskogel), +2 EUR keycard; 2096 m is the full Skicircus maximum; from Italy via Brenner-Inntal or Felbertauern tunnel (toll).

score_notes: Asitz/Steinberg side has moderate off-piste and belongs to the Skicircus with FWT venue Fieberbrunn, but is lower and more piste-oriented than Saalbach; Leoganger Steinberge tours are few and steep, limited variety.
comments: Same Ski ALPIN CARD pricing as Saalbach: peak 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 at 82 EUR fixed, winter start 74 EUR. Base = Asitzbahn valley station (Leogang-Huetten). 2025/26 opened 28 Nov 2025 (Asitzbahn, Poltenlift), full Skicircus connections 5 Dec 2025. No winter pass closure from Italy (Brenner/Pass Thurn).

score_notes: Marked freeride routes and Freeride Park on Schattberg/Zwoelferkogel and lift link to FWT venue Fieberbrunn justify 4.0; Glemmtal touring is gentle grass-mountain terrain with limited high-alpine variety. Calibrated to 3.5 (piste-oriented resort).
comments: Peak 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 at 82 EUR fixed (Ski ALPIN CARD, also valid Schmittenhoehe and Kitzsteinhorn = 408 km network, areas not lift-linked); winter start 27.11-18.12.2026 at 74 EUR. 2025/26 opened 28 Nov 2025 with limited lifts (Schoenleiten, Asitz), all connections from 5 Dec 2025. From Italy via Brenner/Pass Thurn - no winter pass closure. Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Staller Sattel.

score_notes: Family-oriented, low-altitude Ligurian Alps resort with little documented off-piste; local touring limited by snow reliability.
comments: Extraordinary early opening Sun 23 Nov 2025 (partial lifts), Caudano-Vallon 6-seater from 24 Nov, all lifts from Thu 27 Nov 2025, Open Season show 6-7 Dec; 2026/27 opening not published (skiinfo 5 Dec 2026 vs skiresort 26 Nov 2026). 2025/26 listino: high season 26 Dec 2025-6 Jan 2026 fixed EUR 52 at ticket office, online dynamic from EUR 39 (Tue-Thu) and promo EUR 27; keycard EUR 2.50; new 8-seat Blu chairlift planned for 2026/27; Prato Nevoso alone about 50 km, top about 2000 m (skiinfo/neveitalia).

score_notes: Low-altitude family village area; negligible freeride or touring reputation.
comments: Labellemontagne operator; 2026/27 Val d'Arly adult day 45 EUR window / 43.50 EUR web, Espace Diamant 52 EUR, Saturday 25 EUR; 2069 m is the Espace Diamant/Val d'Arly high point per Labellemontagne; skiinfo lists 26 Dec 2026 opening - official 19 Dec used; season ends late March

score_notes: Small village area (Cret du Midi); no freeride or touring reputation.
comments: Haute-Savoie village of Espace Diamant, same operator/pass as NDB; 2026/27 Val d'Arly day 45 EUR window / 43.50 EUR web, Espace Diamant 52 EUR; 2025/26 opening 20 Dec 2025 from search summary (not directly verified on the official page); season ends 27-29 March

score_notes: Rolling Nockberge terrain famous for World Cup pistes (Franz Klammer downhill) but with little freeride; Nockberge touring (Falkert, Klomnock, Mallnock) is gentle and limited in variety.
comments: Fixed single day price, no dynamic pricing: 2026/27 adult 1-day 73.00 EUR valid 04.12.2026-29.03.2027 (2025/26 was 69.50 EUR per skiresort.com); multi-day passes have a peak-season tariff 25.12.2026-13.03.2027. Official planned 2026/27 start is 4 Dec 2026 (skiresort.com shows 5 Dec). Also part of Kaerntner Skipass (multi-day). Base = Kaiserburgbahn valley station. From Italy via Tarvisio-Villach-Feld am See (B98) - open all winter; the Nockalmstrasse is closed in winter but is not the access road. Elevation from skiresort.com.

score_notes: Low-altitude Vercors forest resort with little lift-served off-piste; Vercors plateau touring (Grande Moucherolle, Cornafion, Pic Saint-Michel) is popular from Grenoble but snow-dependent.
comments: 2025/26 planned pre-openings 29-30 Nov and 6-7 Dec 2025 then continuous from 13 Dec 2025 to 29 Mar 2026, actual pre-opening not confirmed; official offer page says 13 Dec 2026 (a Sunday) while Parcs & Loisirs says 12 Dec 2026; main base Cote 2000/Les Glovettes car park (1150 m) above Villard; 2025/26 adult day 43 from skiresort/aggregators, operator (SEVLC) price page is JS-only; Corrençon (Clos de la Balme) is the second entry.

score_notes: Record snowfall village (approx. 9 m/season) with documented tree/bowl freeride and marked ski routes, but modest altitude; touring limited.
comments: 2025/26 high-season day ticket 72.50 (bergfex); 2026/27 prices not yet published; official site is JS-only (no data extractable, webcam page 404), bergfex used. Access from Milan via Bregenzerwald (Faschina/Furkajoch pass roads: Furkajoch closed in winter, Faschinajoch open). Input skiresort_url pointed to Espace Diamant; correct page is skiresort.com/en/ski-resort/damuels-mellau/. Base = Uga-Express valley station, Damuels.

score_notes: Family-oriented skischaukel with modest off-piste; the Grossarltal is a well-known ski-touring valley with many documented easy-to-moderate day tours (Frauenkogel, Filzmooshoerndl, Kreuzeck), hence 3.5.
comments: Ski amade dynamic pricing (Grossarltal region): main season 19.12.2026-26.03.2027 adult day online 69.50-81.50 EUR, ticket office 81.50 EUR; pre/post 64.50-76.00. Grossarltal day ticket covers Dorfgastein-Grossarltal only (the Gastein ticket also includes it). Base = Panoramabahn valley station, Grossarl. No winter pass closure from Italy (A10 Tauern motorway via St. Johann im Pongau).

score_notes: Open Faces FWQ freeride contests have been staged on the Wiedersbergerhorn and the area markets freeride routes; touring decent but modest (Wiedersbergerhorn, Gratlspitz, Sagtaler Spitzen day tours).
comments: 2025/26: Wiedersbergerhorn weekend ops 29-30.11.2025 announced by lift company (no independent report found), full area incl. Schatzberg from 05.12.2025; 2026/27 peak season 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 71.50 EUR, pre/late season 64.50, fixed prices; base = Wiedersbergerhornbahn valley station, Inneralpbach (Pöglbahn in village alternative); from Italy via Brenner-Inntal, no passes.

score_notes: Schatzberg offers some off-piste but no contest history (Open Faces events were on the Alpbach side); Wildschönau is a popular gentle ski-touring area (Feldalphorn, Breiteggern, Schatzberg) with many easy documented tours but low altitude.
comments: Area first day 29.11.2025 was at Wiedersbergerhorn (Alpbach side); Wildschönau's own Schatzberg lifts (Auffach) opened 05.12.2025 (published 05.12.25-06.04.26); villages Niederau/Oberau/Auffach, base = Schatzbergbahn valley station Auffach (Markbachjochbahn Niederau alternative); 2026/27 peak season 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 71.50 EUR, pre/late season 64.50, fixed prices; from Italy via Brenner-Inntal, no passes.

score_notes: Low family resort (top ~2000 m) with little off-piste and no events; limited touring (Mont Mounier) with variable snow.
comments: Opening date conflict: official event page (now offline) and France 3/Monaco Tribune give 13 Dec 2025 (promo weekend 15 EUR) while skiinfo/forfait2ski give 19-20 Dec 2025; 2026/27 date (19 Dec 2026) and 37 EUR price come from skiinfo/forfait2ski (also 37 EUR in 2025/26), not found on the JS-heavy official site; elevation 2020 m per skiresort, 2100 m per skiinfo; from Italy via Nice and the Var/Cians valleys. Aggregator/press lists a provisional 2026/27 opening of 2026-12-19, not confirmed by the operator; date shown is the 2025/26 opening shifted.

score_notes: Nyon/Chamossière offer some steep off-piste; touring modest (Roc d'Enfer, Pointe de Nantaux nearby).
comments: Base = Pléney cable car in the village. From Italy via Grand-Saint-Bernard/Martigny-Monthey-Pas de Morgins or Geneva-Thonon; Col de Joux Plane closed in winter. 2025/26: official 20 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026 with pre-opening 13-19 Dec possible (bergfex season from 13 Dec); Avoriaz reachable from 12 Dec via Prodains. 2026/27: Pléney desks from 21 Nov, Nyon from 19 Dec 2026; Les Gets lift-co lists partial 12 Dec/general 19 Dec 2026 - Morzine partial date not published. Prices web 50/desk 56 EUR until 19 Mar 2027 (Saturdays 40); Portes du Soleil 69 web/73 desk (+3 EUR card). Top 2019 m (Pointe de Nyon) per bergfex; skiinfo 2000 m.

score_notes: World-Cup piste resort at 745-2,015 m with limited off-piste (some on Reiteralm/Hochwurzen); the Schladminger Tauern are a popular touring region (Giglachseen, Hochwurzen and Planai piste tours), so touring 3.5.
comments: Ski amade dynamic pricing (Schladming-Dachstein region): main season 19.12.2026-26.03.2027 adult day online 69.50-81.50 EUR, ticket office 81.50 EUR; pre/post 64.50-76.00. 2025/26 per mountain: Reiteralm 21 Nov, Planai 22 Nov, Hauser Kaibling 29 Nov, Hochwurzen 5 Dec 2025 (ski-opening event 5-7 Dec). 2026/27: Reiteralm 20 Nov, Hauser Kaibling 28 Nov, Hochwurzen 4 Dec 2026, Planai TBA; ski-opening event 11-12 Dec 2026. Base = Planai valley station, Schladming. Elevation/km from skiresort.com. No winter pass closure from Italy (A10 Tauern motorway via Radstadt).

score_notes: Family/intermediate area (Mont Chéry, Chavannes); little serious off-piste or touring.
comments: Base = Chavannes lifts/front de neige (underground Chavannes car park). Pre-opening 13-19 Dec 2025 was possible but not confirmed; official 20 Dec 2025-12 Apr 2026. 2026/27: partial 12 Dec, general 19 Dec 2026, closing 11 Apr 2027. Prices web 50/desk 56 EUR (Saturdays 40); Portes du Soleil 69/73. Top 2002 m per bergfex/skiinfo (Les Gets side); Morzine side 2019 m. Access from Italy via Pas de Morgins-Morzine or Geneva-Cluses-Taninges.

score_notes: Some tree and side-country runs (Gartnerkofel, Trogkofel) and marked deep-snow areas but no notable freeride reputation; Carnic Alps touring around Nassfeld is pleasant but limited in scale.
comments: Fixed seasonal pricing (no dynamic pricing): 2026/27 adult 1-day 73.00 EUR in high season (25.12.2026-13.03.2027), 67.50 EUR in low season (04.12.-24.12.2026 and 14.03.-04.04.2027). Passo Pramollo/Nassfeld pass road from Pontebba (Italy) is closed in winter - access from Italy via Tarvisio-Arnoldstein-Hermagor to Troepolach (Millennium-Express valley station, base used here) or on to Sonnenalpe Nassfeld from the Austrian side. Elevation from skiresort.com. Milan route forced via Villach to avoid closed Pramollo/Nassfeld pass (Italian ramp).

score_notes: Small family area with minor off-piste; popular touring on Haute Pointe, Pointe de Chalune and Roc d'Enfer from Sommand/Praz de Lys.
comments: Base = Praz de Lys (Les Molliettes) car park reached from Taninges (D308); Sommand base reached from Mieussy. 2025/26 first weekend 13-14 Dec 2025 per skiinfo (bergfex lists 20 Dec) - not verified; closed 6 Apr 2026. 2026/27: 19 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027; day pass 37.50 EUR (Saturdays 30 EUR; 2025/26 was 36). Top: OT/skiinfo/bergfex 2000 m, skiresort.com 1966 m. Access from Italy via Mont Blanc tunnel-Cluses-Taninges.

score_notes: Dedicated Bichlalm freeride area and Zweitausender/Resterhöhe off-piste, but low grass mountains with limited steep terrain and no contest history; touring: popular easy Kitzbühel Alps day tours (Bichlalm, Kitzbüheler Horn) with modest variety.
comments: Price = Premium-Saison 20.12.2026-13.03.2027 ticket-office price 83 EUR (Vorteils 76, Spar 69); online booking cheaper (flexible online pricing); 2025/26: Resterkogel (Pass Thurn) from 07.11.2025 weekends only via snow-farming, Hahnenkamm/Fleckalm from 22.11.2025, Horn 06.12.2025, full link 12.12.2025; 2026/27 Resterkogel 06.11.2026, Hahnenkamm 21-22.11.2026, core area 27/28.11.2026; base = Hahnenkammbahn; from Italy via Brenner-Inntal or Felbertauern tunnel (toll) + Pass Thurn (open winter).

score_notes: Dedicated Bichlalm freeride area and Zweitausender/Resterhöhe off-piste, but low grass mountains with limited steep terrain and no contest history; touring: popular easy Kitzbühel Alps day tours (Bichlalm, Kitzbüheler Horn) with modest variety.
comments: Area date 07.11.2025 refers to Resterkogel (Pass Thurn); Kirchberg's own Fleckalmbahn ran from 22.11.2025 (2026/27 planned 27/28.11.2026); base = Fleckalmbahn valley station at Klausen (Maierlbahn in village alternative); price = Premium-Saison 20.12.2026-13.03.2027 ticket-office 83 EUR, online cheaper (flexible pricing); from Italy via Brenner-Inntal or Felbertauern (toll). Date refers to Kirchberg's Fleckalmbahn; KitzSki area opens earlier at Resterkogel (06.11.2026).

score_notes: Schmittenhoehe is a piste-oriented 2,000 m grass mountain with only modest side-country; touring is limited to piste tours and a few Pinzgau day tours, so both scores stay at 3.0.
comments: Day ticket = Ski ALPIN CARD (fixed price, valid Schmitten + Kitzsteinhorn + Skicircus): peak 19.12.2026-12.03.2027 at 82 EUR, winter start/bonus 74 EUR. 2025/26: preview weekend 29-30 Nov 2025 (trassXpress, areitXpress, Glocknerbahn, Hirschkogel, Breiteck) announced officially, regular start 5 Dec 2025 - verify preview ran. Schmitten's own 2026/27 start date not yet published (ALPIN CARD winter-start ticket period begins 27.11.2026). Base = Schmittenhoehebahn valley station (alt. areitXpress Schuettdorf). Milan route uses OSRM alternative avoiding closed Staller Sattel.

score_notes: Piste-focused 900-2,000 m grass mountains with only some tree runs and no freeride reputation; touring is limited to piste tours and easy Pongau day tours.
comments: Ski amade dynamic pricing: 12 Peaks region main season 19.12.2026-26.03.2027 adult day online 69.00-81.00 EUR, ticket office 81.00 EUR (other Ski amade regions 81.00-81.50); pre/post season 64.50-75.50. One-day Ski amade tickets valid only in the purchased region. 12 Peaks ski connection/winter opening planned 5 Dec 2026. Elevation from skiresort.com. Base = Achterjet valley station. From Italy via Tauern motorway A10 or Brenner - no winter closure.

score_notes: Alpendorf/Gernkogel side is family and piste oriented with negligible freeride; touring limited to a few easy Pongau tours.
comments: Snow Space season opened 29 Nov 2025 in Flachau/Wagrain, but Alpendorf lifts started Fri 5 Dec 2025 (12 Peaks connection 6 Dec 2025). 2026/27 published start 28 Nov 2026 is for Snow Space as a whole; Alpendorf may again open later. Ski amade dynamic pricing (12 Peaks region): main season online 69.00-81.00 EUR, office 81.00 EUR. Base = Alpendorf gondola valley station. Elevation from skiresort.com.

score_notes: Same piste-oriented Snow Space terrain (Griessenkareck/Grafenberg) with little off-piste; touring options are modest local tours (Kleinarl valley) only.

score_notes: Rolling nordic-oriented plateau with limited off-piste (Bisanne, Legette); Beaufortain touring nearby (Cret du Rey, Mont Clocher) but the resort is not a hub.
comments: Pre-opening 6-7 Dec 2025 with 4 lifts was planned, snow-dependent, not verified; Espace Diamant link opened 19-20 Dec 2025; 2026/27: Les Saisies day 46 EUR, Espace Diamant 52 EUR (official OT tariff, updated 22 Sep 2026); 2026/27 opening date not yet on official site (skiinfo lists 5 Dec 2026, unconfirmed); Crest-Voland/Cohennoz and Flumet are villages, not rows
